import os
import sys
import json
import UnityPy

def extract_ceto_from_data(data_dir):
    if not os.path.exists(data_dir):
        print(f"Error: Directory not found -> {data_dir}")
        return

    results = []
    files_scanned = 0
    objects_scanned = 0

    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(data_dir):
        for fname in sorted(files):
            fpath = os.path.join(root, fname)
            if fname.endswith((".resS", ".resource", ".dll", ".exe", ".txt", ".json", ".py")):
                continue
            try:
                env = UnityPy.load(fpath)
            except Exception:
                continue

            files_scanned += 1
            for obj in env.objects:
                objects_scanned += 1
                try:
                    if obj.type.name == "MonoBehaviour":
                        tree = obj.read_typetree()
                        script_info = tree.get("m_Script", {})
                        go_info = tree.get("m_GameObject", {})

                        # Check if name or keys belong to Ceto
                        name = str(tree.get("m_Name", ""))
                        is_ceto = "ceto" in name.lower() or any("ceto" in str(k).lower() for k in tree.keys())

                        # Also check script class name via PPtr if available
                        script_name = ""
                        if isinstance(script_info, dict) and script_info.get("m_PathID", 0) != 0:
                            try:
                                s_obj = obj.assets_file.objects.get(script_info["m_PathID"])
                                if s_obj:
                                    s_data = s_obj.read()
                                    script_name = getattr(s_data, "m_ClassName", "") or getattr(s_data, "name", "")
                                    if "ceto" in script_name.lower() or "ocean" in script_name.lower():
                                        is_ceto = True
                            except Exception:
                                pass

                        if is_ceto:
                            results.append({
                                "file": os.path.relpath(fpath, data_dir),
                                "path_id": obj.path_id,
                                "script_class": script_name or "MonoBehaviour",
                                "gameobject_path_id": go_info.get("m_PathID") if isinstance(go_info, dict) else None,
                                "data": tree
                            })
                    elif obj.type.name == "GameObject":
                        data = obj.read()
                        go_name = getattr(data, "name", "") or getattr(data, "m_Name", "")
                        if "ceto" in go_name.lower():
                            results.append({
                                "file": os.path.relpath(fpath, data_dir),
                                "path_id": obj.path_id,
                                "type": "GameObject",
                                "name": go_name
                            })
                except Exception:
                    continue

    out_json = "ceto_ocean_full.json"
    with open(out_json, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)

    out_txt = "ceto_ocean_summary.txt"
    with open(out_txt, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(f"DATA DIR: {data_dir}\n")
        f.write(f"FILES SCANNED: {files_scanned}\n")
        f.write(f"OBJECTS SCANNED: {objects_scanned}\n")
        f.write(f"CETO ITEMS FOUND: {len(results)}\n")
        f.write("=" * 60 + "\n\n")
        for idx, item in enumerate(results, 1):
            f.write(f"#{idx} | FILE: {item.get('file')} | PATH_ID: {item.get('path_id')}\n")
            if item.get("type") == "GameObject":
                f.write(f"  TYPE: GameObject | NAME: {item.get('name')}\n")
            else:
                f.write(f"  CLASS: {item.get('script_class')} | GO_PATH_ID: {item.get('gameobject_path_id')}\n")
                data_keys = [k for k in item.get("data", {}).keys() if not k.startswith("m_")]
                f.write(f"  FIELDS: {data_keys}\n")
            f.write("-" * 60 + "\n")

    print(f"Done! Scanned {files_scanned} files ({objects_scanned} objects).")
    print(f"Found {len(results)} Ceto/Ocean items.")
    print(f"Saved -> {out_json}")
    print(f"Saved -> {out_txt}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    target = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/storage/emulated/0/Download/Stranded-Deep-Original/Stranded Deep/Stranded_Deep_Data"
    extract_ceto_from_data(target)

def s_val(v):
    return "" if v is None else str(getattr(v, "value", v))

def build_metadata_maps(pe):
    tdefs = pe.net.mdtables.TypeDef.rows
    mdefs = pe.net.mdtables.MethodDef.rows
    fdefs = pe.net.mdtables.Field.rows
    mrefs = pe.net.mdtables.MemberRef.rows
    trefs = pe.net.mdtables.TypeRef.rows

    owners = list()
    for idx, td in enumerate(tdefs):
        ns = s_val(td.TypeNamespace)
        nm = s_val(td.TypeName)
        fn = f"{ns}.{nm}" if ns else nm
        ml = td.MethodList
        if isinstance(ml, list) and ml:
            s_rid = int(ml.__getitem__(0).row_index)
            if 1 <= s_rid <= len(mdefs):
                owners.append((fn, s_rid))

    rid_to_owner = {}
    for pos, (fn, s_rid) in enumerate(owners):
        e_rid = owners.__getitem__(pos + 1).__getitem__(1) if pos + 1 < len(owners) else len(mdefs) + 1
        for r in range(s_rid, e_rid):
            rid_to_owner.update({r: fn})

    tok_map = {}
    for r, td in enumerate(tdefs, 1):
        ns = s_val(td.TypeNamespace)
        nm = s_val(td.TypeName)
        tok_map.update({0x02000000 | r: f"TypeDef {ns}.{nm}" if ns else f"TypeDef {nm}"})
    for r, tr in enumerate(trefs, 1):
        ns = s_val(tr.TypeNamespace)
        nm = s_val(tr.TypeName)
        tok_map.update({0x01000000 | r: f"TypeRef {ns}.{nm}" if ns else f"TypeRef {nm}"})
    for r, fd in enumerate(fdefs, 1):
        tok_map.update({0x04000000 | r: f"Field {s_val(fd.Name)}"})
    for r, md in enumerate(mdefs, 1):
        ow = rid_to_owner.get(r, "?")
        tok_map.update({0x06000000 | r: f"MethodDef {ow}.{s_val(md.Name)}"})
    for r, mr in enumerate(mrefs, 1):
        tok_map.update({0x0A000000 | r: f"MemberRef {s_val(mr.Name)}"})
    return tdefs, mdefs, rid_to_owner, tok_map

def read_method_body(pe, rva):
    if not rva:
        return None
    off = pe.get_offset_from_rva(rva)
    data = pe.__data__
    b0 = data.__getitem__(off)
    hdr_type = b0 & 0x03
    if hdr_type == 2:
        csz = b0 >> 2
        b_start = off + 1
    elif hdr_type == 3:
        flags = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, off).__getitem__(0)
        hdr_size = ((flags >> 12) & 0x0F) * 4
        csz = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, off + 4).__getitem__(0)
        b_start = off + hdr_size
    else:
        return None
    return off, b_start, bytes(data[b_start : b_start + csz])

def disasm_il(code, tok_map, pe):
    out = list()
    i, n = 0, len(code)
    while i < n:
        ioff = i
        op = code.__getitem__(i)
        i += 1
        if op == 0xFE:
            if i >= n:
                break
            op2 = code.__getitem__(i)
            i += 1
            mnem, sz = OP2.get(op2, (f"fe_{op2:02x}", 0))
            raw = bytes([0xFE, op2]) + code[i : i + sz]
        else:
            mnem, sz = OP1.get(op, (f"op_{op:02x}", 0))
            raw = bytes([op]) + code[i : i + sz]
        if sz == -1:
            cnt = struct.unpack_from("<I", code, i).__getitem__(0)
            i += 4 + cnt * 4
            out.append(f"  IL_{ioff:04X}: {mnem:<14} ({cnt} targets)")
            continue
        arg_bytes = code[i : i + sz]
        i += sz
        opr = ""
        if sz == 1 and len(arg_bytes) == 1:
            v = struct.unpack("<b" if "br" in mnem or "leave" in mnem or "ldc.i4.s" in mnem else "<B", arg_bytes).__getitem__(0)
            opr = f"IL_{i + v:04X}" if ("br" in mnem or "leave" in mnem) else str(v)
        elif sz == 2 and len(arg_bytes) == 2:
            opr = str(struct.unpack("<H", arg_bytes).__getitem__(0))
        elif sz == 4 and len(arg_bytes) == 4:
            if mnem == "ldc.r4":
                opr = f"{struct.unpack('<f', arg_bytes).__getitem__(0):.6g}"
            elif "br" in mnem or "leave" in mnem:
                v = struct.unpack("<i", arg_bytes).__getitem__(0)
                opr = f"IL_{i + v:04X}"
            elif mnem == "ldc.i4":
                opr = str(struct.unpack("<i", arg_bytes).__getitem__(0))
            else:
                tok = struct.unpack("<I", arg_bytes).__getitem__(0)
                if (tok >> 24) == 0x70 and hasattr(pe.net, "user_strings"):
                    us = pe.net.user_strings.get(tok & 0x00FFFFFF)
                    opr = f"0x{tok:08X} {repr(us.value) if us else ''}"
                else:
                    opr = f"0x{tok:08X} [{tok_map.get(tok, 'TOK')}]"
        elif sz == 8 and len(arg_bytes) == 8:
            opr = f"{struct.unpack('<d', arg_bytes).__getitem__(0):.10g}" if mnem == "ldc.r8" else str(struct.unpack("<q", arg_bytes).__getitem__(0))
        out.append(f"  IL_{ioff:04X}: {raw.hex():<22} | {mnem:<14} {opr}")
    return out

def classify_ceto_type(full_name):
    gpu_cpu_keywords = (
        "Displacement", "WaveSpectrum", "Fourier", "Spectrum", "Query",
        "Interpolated", "CBUtility", "RTUtility", "Buffer", "Task", "Thread"
    )
    if any(k in full_name for k in gpu_cpu_keywords):
        return "GPU_CPU"
    return "OCEAN_CORE"

def write_chunked_report(prefix, title, header_lines, method_blocks):
    part_idx = 1
    cur_lines = list(header_lines)
    cur_bytes = sum(len(x.encode("utf-8")) + 1 for x in cur_lines)
    written = list()

    for blk in method_blocks:
        blk_bytes = sum(len(x.encode("utf-8")) + 1 for x in blk)
        if cur_bytes + blk_bytes > MAX_PART_BYTES and len(cur_lines) > len(header_lines):
            p = OUT_DIR / f"{prefix}_PART_{part_idx:02d}.txt"
            p.write_text("\n".join(cur_lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
            written.append((p.name, p.stat().st_size))
            part_idx += 1
            cur_lines = [
                f"{title} — CONTINUATION PART {part_idx:02d}",
                "=" * 90,
                "",
            ]
            cur_bytes = sum(len(x.encode("utf-8")) + 1 for x in cur_lines)
        cur_lines.extend(blk)
        cur_bytes += blk_bytes

    p = OUT_DIR / f"{prefix}_PART_{part_idx:02d}.txt"
    p.write_text("\n".join(cur_lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    written.append((p.name, p.stat().st_size))
    return written

def main():
    raw_dll = DLL_PATH.read_bytes()
    sha256 = hashlib.sha256(raw_dll).hexdigest()
    pe = dnfile.dnPE(data=raw_dll)
    tdefs, mdefs, rid_to_owner, tok_map = build_metadata_maps(pe)

    ocean_blocks = list()
    gpucpu_blocks = list()
    combined_blocks = list()
    ocean_cnt, gpucpu_cnt = 0, 0

    for rid, md in enumerate(mdefs, 1):
        owner = rid_to_owner.get(rid, "")
        if not owner.startswith("Ceto"):
            continue
        mname = s_val(md.Name)
        tok = 0x06000000 | rid
        rva = int(getattr(md, "Rva", 0) or 0)
        cat = classify_ceto_type(owner)
        body = read_method_body(pe, rva)
        if body is None:
            blk = [
                "=" * 90,
                f"[{cat}] CLASS: {owner} | METHOD: {mname} | TOKEN: 0x{tok:08X} | RID: {rid} | RVA: 0x0 (Abstract/Extern)",
                "",
            ]
        else:
            off, b_st, code = body
            il_lines = disasm_il(code, tok_map, pe)
            blk = [
                "=" * 90,
                f"[{cat}] CLASS: {owner} | METHOD: {mname} | TOKEN: 0x{tok:08X} | RID: {rid} | RVA: 0x{rva:X} | OFF: 0x{off:X} | SIZE: {len(code)}B",
                "-" * 90,
                f"RAW_HEX: {code.hex()}",
            ] + il_lines + [""]

        if cat == "OCEAN_CORE":
            ocean_blocks.append(blk)
            ocean_cnt += 1
        else:
            gpucpu_blocks.append(blk)
            gpucpu_cnt += 1
        combined_blocks.append(blk)

    base_hdr = [
        "CASTAWAY-DEPTHS — LOCKED DIRECTORY DIRECT BINARY EXTRACTION",
        f"LOCK_ROOT : {LOCK_ROOT}",
        f"DLL_PATH  : {DLL_PATH}",
        f"DLL_SIZE  : {len(raw_dll)} bytes | SHA256: {sha256}",
        f"SPLIT_RULE: Strict < {MAX_PART_BYTES} bytes per file (< 10 MB)",
        "=" * 90,
        "",
    ]

    w_ocean = write_chunked_report("1_OCEAN_CORE", "OCEAN CORE DUMP", base_hdr + [f"CATEGORY: OCEAN CORE | Methods={ocean_cnt}", ""], ocean_blocks)
    w_gpucpu = write_chunked_report("2_GPU_CPU_PIPELINE", "GPU/CPU DISPLACEMENT & SPECTRUM DUMP", base_hdr + [f"CATEGORY: GPU/CPU PIPELINE | Methods={gpucpu_cnt}", ""], gpucpu_blocks)
    w_comb = write_chunked_report("3_COMBINED_OCEAN_GPU_CPU", "COMBINED OCEAN + GPU/CPU MASTER DUMP", base_hdr + [f"CATEGORY: COMBINED MASTER | TotalMethods={ocean_cnt + gpucpu_cnt}", ""], combined_blocks)

    print("LOCKED EXTRACTION COMPLETE! Output directory:", OUT_DIR)
    for label, flist in [("1. OCEAN CORE", w_ocean), ("2. GPU/CPU PIPELINE", w_gpucpu), ("3. COMBINED MASTER", w_comb)]:
        print(f"  {label}:")
        for fname, fsz in flist:
            print(f"    -> {fname} ({fsz:,} bytes / {fsz / (1024*1024):.2f} MB)")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


--- FILE: /storage/emulated/0/Download/Stranded-Deep-Original/find_displacement_querywaves.py ---
import struct

DLL_PATH = "/storage/emulated/0/Download/Stranded-Deep-Original/Stranded Deep/Stranded_Deep_Data/Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll"

def rva_to_offset(rva, sections):
    for vaddr, vsize, raw_ptr, raw_size in sections:
        if vaddr <= rva < vaddr + max(vsize, raw_size):
            return raw_ptr + (rva - vaddr)
    return None

def main():
    with open(DLL_PATH, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()

    e_lfanew = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, 0x3C)[0]
    num_sections = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, e_lfanew + 6)[0]
    opt_hdr_size = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, e_lfanew + 20)[0]
    opt_off = e_lfanew + 24
    magic = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, opt_off)[0]
    dd_off = opt_off + (96 if magic == 0x10B else 112)
    cli_rva, _ = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, dd_off + 14 * 8)

    sec_off = opt_off + opt_hdr_size
    sections = []
    for i in range(num_sections):
        s = data[sec_off + i*40 : sec_off + (i+1)*40]
        vsize, vaddr, raw_size, raw_ptr = struct.unpack_from("<IIII", s, 8)
        sections.append((vaddr, vsize, raw_ptr, raw_size))

    cli_off = rva_to_offset(cli_rva, sections)
    meta_rva, _ = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, cli_off + 8)
    meta_off = rva_to_offset(meta_rva, sections)

    ver_len = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, meta_off + 12)[0]
    pos = meta_off + 16 + ver_len
    while pos % 4 != 0:
        pos += 1
    num_streams = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, pos + 2)[0]
    pos += 4

    streams = {}
    for _ in range(num_streams):
        st_off, st_size = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, pos)
        pos += 8
        name_bytes = bytearray()
        while pos < len(data) and data[pos] != 0:
            name_bytes.append(data[pos])
            pos += 1
        pos += 1
        while pos % 4 != 0:
            pos += 1
        streams[name_bytes.decode("ascii", errors="replace")] = (meta_off + st_off, st_size)

    t_off, _ = streams["#~"]
    s_off, s_size = streams["#Strings"]
    strings_blob = data[s_off : s_off + s_size]

    def get_str(idx):
        if idx >= len(strings_blob):
            return ""
        end = strings_blob.find(b"\x00", idx)
        return strings_blob[idx:end if end != -1 else len(strings_blob)].decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

    heap_sizes = data[t_off + 6]
    str_idx_sz = 4 if (heap_sizes & 0x01) else 2
    guid_idx_sz = 4 if (heap_sizes & 0x02) else 2
    blob_idx_sz = 4 if (heap_sizes & 0x04) else 2
    valid_mask = struct.unpack_from("<Q", data, t_off + 8)[0]

    row_counts = {}
    cur = t_off + 24
    for tid in range(64):
        if (valid_mask >> tid) & 1:
            row_counts[tid] = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, cur)[0]
            cur += 4

    def tbl_idx_sz(tid):
        return 4 if row_counts.get(tid, 0) >= 65536 else 2

    max_tdr = max(row_counts.get(2, 0), row_counts.get(1, 0), row_counts.get(27, 0))
    tdr_sz = 4 if (max_tdr << 2) >= 65536 else 2
    field_idx_sz = tbl_idx_sz(4)
    method_idx_sz = tbl_idx_sz(6)
    param_idx_sz = tbl_idx_sz(8)
    typedef_row_sz = 4 + str_idx_sz + str_idx_sz + tdr_sz + field_idx_sz + method_idx_sz
    field_row_sz = 2 + str_idx_sz + blob_idx_sz
    method_row_sz = 4 + 2 + 2 + str_idx_sz + blob_idx_sz + param_idx_sz

    table_starts = {}
    t_cur = cur
    for tid in range(64):
        if (valid_mask >> tid) & 1:
            table_starts[tid] = t_cur
            cnt = row_counts.get(tid, 0)
            if tid == 0:
                t_cur += cnt * (2 + str_idx_sz + guid_idx_sz * 3)
            elif tid == 1:
                max_rs = max(row_counts.get(0, 0), row_counts.get(26, 0), row_counts.get(2, 0), row_counts.get(35, 0))
                rs_sz = 4 if (max_rs << 2) >= 65536 else 2
                t_cur += cnt * (rs_sz + str_idx_sz * 2)
            elif tid == 2:
                t_cur += cnt * typedef_row_sz
            elif tid == 4:
                t_cur += cnt * field_row_sz
            elif tid == 6:
                t_cur += cnt * method_row_sz
            else:
                break

    def read_idx(off, sz):
        return struct.unpack_from("<I", data, off)[0] if sz == 4 else struct.unpack_from("<H", data, off)[0]

    m_start = table_starts[6]
    m_count = row_counts.get(6, 0)
    methods = [(struct.unpack_from("<I", data, m_start + i * method_row_sz)[0],
                get_str(read_idx(m_start + i * method_row_sz + 8, str_idx_sz)))
               for i in range(m_count)]

    td_start = table_starts[2]
    td_count = row_counts.get(2, 0)
    fl_off = 4 + str_idx_sz + str_idx_sz + tdr_sz
    ml_off = fl_off + field_idx_sz

    target_types = {"DisplacementBufferCPU", "DisplacementBufferGPU", "QueryDisplacements"}

    for i in range(td_count):
        roff = td_start + i * typedef_row_sz
        tname = get_str(read_idx(roff + 4, str_idx_sz))
        tns = get_str(read_idx(roff + 4 + str_idx_sz, str_idx_sz))
        m_first = read_idx(roff + ml_off, method_idx_sz) - 1
        m_last = read_idx(td_start + (i + 1) * typedef_row_sz + ml_off, method_idx_sz) - 1 if i + 1 < td_count else len(methods)

        if tname in target_types:
            print(f"\n[{tns}.{tname}]")
            for idx in range(max(0, m_first), min(len(methods), m_last)):
                mrva, mname = methods[idx]
                foff = rva_to_offset(mrva, sections) if mrva else None
                print(f"  {mname:28s} | RVA=0x{mrva:08x} | FileOff={f'0x{foff:x}' if foff else 'None'}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

--- FILE: /storage/emulated/0/Download/Stranded-Deep-Original/find_ocean_points.py ---
import os
import sys
import json
import UnityPy

TARGET_SCENES = {"level0", "level2", "level3", "level4"}
PARENT_PIDS = {185, 119}

def dump_ocean_related(data_dir):
    found = []
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(data_dir):
        for fname in sorted(files):
            if fname not in TARGET_SCENES and not fname.startswith("sharedassets"):
                continue
            fpath = os.path.join(root, fname)
            try:
                env = UnityPy.load(fpath)
            except Exception:
                continue

            for obj in env.objects:
                try:
                    tname = obj.type.name
                    if tname == "Transform":
                        data = obj.read()
                        pid = obj.path_id
                        m_father = getattr(data, "m_Father", None)
                        father_pid = getattr(m_father, "m_PathID", 0) if m_father else 0
                        m_go = getattr(data, "m_GameObject", None)
                        go_pid = getattr(m_go, "m_PathID", 0) if m_go else 0
                        pos = getattr(data, "m_LocalPosition", None)
                        pos_tuple = (round(pos.x, 4), round(pos.y, 4), round(pos.z, 4)) if pos else None
                        children = [getattr(c, "m_PathID", None) for c in getattr(data, "m_Children", [])]

                        if pid in PARENT_PIDS or father_pid in PARENT_PIDS or go_pid in {29, 24, 139, 5}:
                            found.append({
                                "file": fname,
                                "type": "Transform",
                                "path_id": pid,
                                "go_path_id": go_pid,
                                "father_path_id": father_pid,
                                "children_tr_pids": children,
                                "local_pos": pos_tuple
                            })
                    elif tname == "GameObject":
                        data = obj.read()
                        gname = getattr(data, "m_Name", "") or getattr(data, "name", "")
                        if any(k in gname.lower() for k in ("ceto", "ocean", "wave", "point", "buoy", "water")):
                            found.append({
                                "file": fname,
                                "type": "GameObject",
                                "path_id": obj.path_id,
                                "name": gname
                            })
                except Exception:
                    continue

    with open("ocean_points_trace.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(found, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

    print(f"Total matched items: {len(found)}")
    for item in found[:60]:
        print(item)
    print("Saved -> ocean_points_trace.json")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    d = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/storage/emulated/0/Download/Stranded-Deep-Original/Stranded Deep/Stranded_Deep_Data"
    dump_ocean_related(d)

                t_cur += cnt * (2 + str_idx_sz + guid_idx_sz * 3)
            elif tid == 1:
                max_rs = max(row_counts.get(0, 0), row_counts.get(26, 0), row_counts.get(2, 0), row_counts.get(35, 0))
                rs_sz = 4 if (max_rs << 2) >= 65536 else 2
                t_cur += cnt * (rs_sz + str_idx_sz * 2)
            elif tid == 2:
                t_cur += cnt * typedef_row_sz
            elif tid == 4:
                t_cur += cnt * field_row_sz
            elif tid == 6:
                t_cur += cnt * method_row_sz
            else:
                break

    def read_idx(off, sz):
        return struct.unpack_from("<I", data, off)[0] if sz == 4 else struct.unpack_from("<H", data, off)[0]

    m_start = table_starts[6]
    m_count = row_counts.get(6, 0)
    methods = [(struct.unpack_from("<I", data, m_start + i * method_row_sz)[0],
                get_str(read_idx(m_start + i * method_row_sz + 8, str_idx_sz)))
               for i in range(m_count)]

    td_start = table_starts[2]
    td_count = row_counts.get(2, 0)
    fl_off = 4 + str_idx_sz + str_idx_sz + tdr_sz
    ml_off = fl_off + field_idx_sz

    for i in range(td_count):
        roff = td_start + i * typedef_row_sz
        tname = get_str(read_idx(roff + 4, str_idx_sz))
        tns = get_str(read_idx(roff + 4 + str_idx_sz, str_idx_sz))
        m_first = read_idx(roff + ml_off, method_idx_sz) - 1
        m_last = read_idx(td_start + (i + 1) * typedef_row_sz + ml_off, method_idx_sz) - 1 if i + 1 < td_count else len(methods)

        if tname == "WaveSpectrum":
            print(f"[{tns}.{tname}]")
            for idx in range(max(0, m_first), min(len(methods), m_last)):
                mrva, mname = methods[idx]
                foff = rva_to_offset(mrva, sections) if mrva else None
                print(f"  {mname:28s} | RVA=0x{mrva:08x} | FileOff={f'0x{foff:x}' if foff else 'None'}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def val(obj):
    return getattr(obj, "value", obj)

def name_of(obj):
    if obj is None:
        return "?"
    return str(getattr(obj, "Name", obj))

def table_rows(pe, table_name):
    table = getattr(pe.net.mdtables, table_name, None)
    return getattr(table, "rows", []) if table else []

def build_owner_map(pe):
    owners = {}
    for td in table_rows(pe, "TypeDef"):
        ns = name_of(getattr(td, "TypeNamespace", ""))
        tn = name_of(getattr(td, "TypeName", ""))
        full = f"{ns}.{tn}" if ns else tn
        for entry in getattr(td, "MethodList", []):
            method = getattr(entry, "row", None)
            if method is not None:
                owners[id(method)] = full
    return owners

def read_us_string(pe, rid):
    try:
        us = getattr(pe.net, "user_strings", None)
        if us and rid < len(us.__data__):
            raw = us.__data__
            b0 = raw[rid]
            if (b0 & 0x80) == 0:
                length, hdr = b0, 1
            elif (b0 & 0xC0) == 0x80:
                length, hdr = ((b0 & 0x3F) << 8) | raw[rid + 1], 2
            else:
                length = (
                    ((b0 & 0x1F) << 24)
                    | (raw[rid + 1] << 16)
                    | (raw[rid + 2] << 8)
                    | raw[rid + 3]
                )
                hdr = 4
            if length > 1:
                s = raw[rid + hdr : rid + hdr + length - 1].decode(
                    "utf-16le", errors="replace"
                )
                return repr(s)
        return f"US_OFFSET_0x{rid:X}"
    except Exception:
        return f"US_OFFSET_0x{rid:X}"

def resolve_token(pe, token):
    table_id = (token >> 24) & 0xFF
    rid = token & 0x00FFFFFF
    if table_id == 0x70:
        return f"UserString {read_us_string(pe, rid)}"
    names = {
        0x01: "TypeRef", 0x02: "TypeDef", 0x04: "Field",
        0x06: "MethodDef", 0x0A: "MemberRef", 0x1B: "TypeSpec", 0x2B: "MethodSpec",
    }
    table_name = names.get(table_id)
    if not table_name:
        return f"TOKEN 0x{token:08X} table=0x{table_id:02X} rid={rid}"
    rows = table_rows(pe, table_name)
    if not (0 < rid <= len(rows)):
        return f"{table_name} RID {rid} OUT OF RANGE"
    row = rows[rid - 1]
    if table_name in ("TypeRef", "TypeDef"):
        ns = name_of(getattr(row, "TypeNamespace", ""))
        tn = name_of(getattr(row, "TypeName", ""))
        return f"{table_name} {ns}.{tn}" if ns else f"{table_name} {tn}"
    if table_name in ("Field", "MethodDef"):
        return f"{table_name} {name_of(getattr(row, 'Name', '?'))}"
    if table_name == "MemberRef":
        parent = getattr(row, "Class", None)
        parent_row = getattr(parent, "row", None)
        parent_name = name_of(getattr(parent_row, "TypeName", "?")) if parent_row else "?"
        return f"MemberRef {parent_name}.{name_of(getattr(row, 'Name', '?'))}"
    return f"{table_name} RID {rid}"

def parse_eh_sections(raw, eh_start):
    clauses = []
    pos = (eh_start + 3) & ~3
    while pos + 4 <= len(raw):
        kind = raw[pos]
        if (kind & 0x3F) != 0x01:
            break
        is_fat = (kind & 0x40) != 0
        more_sects = (kind & 0x80) != 0
        if is_fat:
            data_size = raw[pos + 1] | (raw[pos + 2] << 8) | (raw[pos + 3] << 16)
            count = (data_size - 4) // 24
            cur = pos + 4
            for _ in range(count):
                if cur + 24 > len(raw):
                    break
                flags, try_off, try_len, h_off, h_len, c_tok = struct.unpack_from("<IIIIII", raw, cur)
                clauses.append({
                    "flags": flags, "try_off": try_off, "try_len": try_len,
                    "handler_off": h_off, "handler_len": h_len, "token": c_tok
                })
                cur += 24
            pos += data_size
        else:
            data_size = raw[pos + 1]
            count = (data_size - 4) // 12
            cur = pos + 4
            for _ in range(count):
                if cur + 12 > len(raw):
                    break
                flags, try_off, try_len, h_off, h_len, c_tok = struct.unpack_from("<HHBHB I", raw, cur)
                clauses.append({
                    "flags": flags, "try_off": try_off, "try_len": try_len,
                    "handler_off": h_off, "handler_len": h_len, "token": c_tok
                })
                cur += 12
            pos += data_size
        if not more_sects:
            break
    return clauses

def read_method_body(pe, rva):
    if not rva:
        return None
    offset = pe.get_offset_from_rva(rva)
    raw = pe.__data__
    first = raw[offset]
    kind = first & 3
    has_more_sects = False
    if kind == 2:
        header_size, code_size, max_stack, local_token = 1, first >> 2, 8, 0
    elif kind == 3:
        flags_size = struct.unpack_from("<H", raw, offset)[0]
        has_more_sects = (flags_size & 0x0008) != 0
        header_dwords = (flags_size >> 12) & 0xF
        header_size = header_dwords * 4
        if header_size < 12:
            raise ValueError("Invalid fat method header")
        max_stack, code_size, local_token = struct.unpack_from("<HII", raw, offset + 2)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown method header kind: {kind}")
    start = offset + header_size
    code = raw[start : start + code_size]
    if len(code) != code_size:
        raise ValueError("Method body is truncated")
    eh_clauses = parse_eh_sections(raw, start + code_size) if has_more_sects else []
    return {
        "offset": offset, "body_offset": start, "header_size": header_size,
        "code_size": code_size, "max_stack": max_stack, "local_token": local_token,
        "code": code, "has_more_sects": has_more_sects, "eh_clauses": eh_clauses,
    }

def read_operand(code, ip, opname):
    if opname not in OPERAND_SIZE and opname not in ZERO_OPERAND_OPS:
        raise ValueError(f"Unmapped operand size for opcode: {opname}")
    size = OPERAND_SIZE.get(opname, 0)
    if size == -1:
        if ip + 4 > len(code):
            raise ValueError("Truncated switch count")
        count = struct.unpack_from("<I", code, ip)[0]
        total = 4 + count * 4
        if ip + total > len(code):
            raise ValueError("Truncated switch targets")
        base = ip + total
        deltas = struct.unpack_from("<" + "i" * count, code, ip + 4)
        targets = [base + d for d in deltas]
        return targets, total, [f"IL_{t:04X}" for t in targets]
    if ip + size > len(code):
        raise ValueError("Truncated operand")
    if size == 0:
        return None, 0, []
    data = code[ip : ip + size]
    if opname == "ldc.i8": return struct.unpack("<q", data)[0], size, []
    if opname == "ldc.r4": return struct.unpack("<f", data)[0], size, []
    if opname == "ldc.r8": return struct.unpack("<d", data)[0], size, []
    if opname in (
        "br.s", "brfalse.s", "brtrue.s", "beq.s", "bge.s", "bgt.s", "ble.s",
        "blt.s", "bne.un.s", "bge.un.s", "bgt.un.s", "ble.un.s", "blt.un.s", "leave.s"
    ):
        delta = struct.unpack("<b", data)[0]
        tgt = ip + size + delta
        return f"IL_{tgt:04X}", size, [f"IL_{tgt:04X}"]
    if opname in (
        "br", "brfalse", "brtrue", "beq", "bge", "bgt", "ble", "blt",
        "bne.un", "bge.un", "bgt.un", "ble.un", "blt.un", "leave"
    ):
        delta = struct.unpack("<i", data)[0]
        tgt = ip + size + delta
        return f"IL_{tgt:04X}", size, [f"IL_{tgt:04X}"]
    if size == 1: return data[0], size, []
    if size == 2: return struct.unpack("<H", data)[0], size, []
    if size == 4: return struct.unpack("<I", data)[0], size, []
    return data.hex(), size, []

def disassemble_and_validate(pe, code, eh_clauses):
    ip = 0
    instructions, errors, branch_checks, ref_tokens = [], [], [], []
    inst_offsets = set()

    while ip < len(code):
        start = ip
        inst_offsets.add(start)
        opcode = code[ip]
        ip += 1
        if opcode == 0xFE:
            if ip >= len(code):
                errors.append(f"0x{start:04X}: truncated FE prefix")
                break
            second = code[ip]
            ip += 1
            opname = FE.get(second)
            if opname is None:
                errors.append(f"0x{start:04X}: unknown FE opcode 0x{second:02X}")
                break
        else:
            opname = OP.get(opcode)
            if opname is None:
                errors.append(f"0x{start:04X}: unknown opcode 0x{opcode:02X}")
                break

        try:
            operand, size, branches = read_operand(code, ip, opname)
        except Exception as exc:
            errors.append(f"0x{start:04X}: {opname}: {exc}")
            break

        ip += size
        for b in branches:
            branch_checks.append((start, opname, int(b.replace("IL_", ""), 16)))

        disp_operand = operand
        if isinstance(operand, int) and size == 4 and opname in TOKEN_OPS:
            resolved = resolve_token(pe, operand)
            tok_str = f"0x{operand:08X} [{resolved}]"
            disp_operand = tok_str
            ref_tokens.append((start, opname, tok_str))

        instructions.append((start, opname, disp_operand, ip - start))

    bad_branches = [
        f"IL_{src:04X} ({opname}) -> IL_{dst:04X} [INVALID BOUNDARY]"
        for src, opname, dst in branch_checks if dst not in inst_offsets
    ]
    bad_eh = [
        f"EH[{idx}] try=0x{c['try_off']:04X} handler=0x{c['handler_off']:04X} [INVALID BOUNDARY]"
        for idx, c in enumerate(eh_clauses)
        if c["try_off"] not in inst_offsets or c["handler_off"] not in inst_offsets
    ]

    return {
        "instructions": instructions,
        "errors": errors,
        "decoded_bytes": sum(i[3] for i in instructions),
        "bad_branches": bad_branches,
        "bad_eh": bad_eh,
        "ref_tokens": ref_tokens,
    }

def format_hex_dump(code, width=32):
hex_str = code.hex().upper()
pairs = [hex_str[i : i + 2] for i in range(0, len(hex_str), 2)]
return "\n".join("    " + " ".join(pairs[i : i + width]) for i in range(0, len(pairs), width))

import os
import struct
from datetime import datetime

BASE_DIR = "/storage/emulated/0/Download/Stranded-Deep-Original"
DATA_DIR = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "Stranded Deep", "Stranded_Deep_Data")
MANAGED_DIR = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "Managed")
OUT_TXT = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "stranded_deep_ocean_evidence_full.txt")

DLL_MAIN = os.path.join(MANAGED_DIR, "Assembly-CSharp.dll")
DLL_FIRSTPASS = os.path.join(MANAGED_DIR, "Assembly-CSharp-firstpass.dll")

    "level0", "level1", "level2", "level3", "level4",

def rva_to_offset(rva, sections):
    for vaddr, vsize, raw_ptr, raw_size in sections:
        if vaddr <= rva < vaddr + max(vsize, raw_size):
            return raw_ptr + (rva - vaddr)
    return None

def parse_dotnet_pe(path):
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return {"exists": False, "path": path}
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()

    info = {
        "exists": True,
        "path": path,
        "size": len(data),
        "parsed": False,
        "error": None,
        "types": [],
        "field_tokens": {},
        "method_tokens": {},
        "method_entries": [],
        "sections": [],
    }

    e_lfanew = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, 0x3C)[0]
    if e_lfanew + 24 > len(data) or data[e_lfanew:e_lfanew+4] != b"PE\x00\x00":
        info["error"] = "Invalid PE signature"
        return info

    num_sections = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, e_lfanew + 6)[0]
    opt_hdr_size = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, e_lfanew + 20)[0]
    opt_off = e_lfanew + 24
    magic = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, opt_off)[0]

    if magic == 0x10B:
        dd_off = opt_off + 96
    elif magic == 0x20B:
        dd_off = opt_off + 112
    else:
        info["error"] = f"Unknown OptionalHeader magic: 0x{magic:x}"
        return info

    cli_rva, cli_size = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, dd_off + 14 * 8)
    if cli_rva == 0:
        info["error"] = "No CLI header (COM descriptor RVA == 0)"
        return info

    sec_off = opt_off + opt_hdr_size
    sections = []
    for i in range(num_sections):
        s = data[sec_off + i*40 : sec_off + (i+1)*40]
        sname = s[:8].rstrip(b"\x00").decode("ascii", errors="replace")
        vsize, vaddr, raw_size, raw_ptr = struct.unpack_from("<IIII", s, 8)
        sections.append((vaddr, vsize, raw_ptr, raw_size))
        info["sections"].append((sname, vaddr, vsize, raw_ptr, raw_size))

    cli_off = rva_to_offset(cli_rva, sections)
    if cli_off is None or cli_off + 16 > len(data):
        info["error"] = "CLI header offset out of range"
        return info

    meta_rva, meta_size = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, cli_off + 8)
    meta_off = rva_to_offset(meta_rva, sections)
    if meta_off is None or meta_off + 16 > len(data) or data[meta_off:meta_off+4] != b"BSJB":
        info["error"] = "Invalid BSJB metadata root"
        return info

    ver_len = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, meta_off + 12)[0]
    pos = meta_off + 16 + ver_len
    while pos % 4 != 0:
        pos += 1
    if pos + 4 > len(data):
        info["error"] = "Truncated stream header"
        return info

    num_streams = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, pos + 2)[0]
    pos += 4

    streams = {}
    for _ in range(num_streams):
        if pos + 8 > len(data):
            break
        st_off, st_size = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, pos)
        pos += 8
        name_bytes = bytearray()
        while pos < len(data) and data[pos] != 0:
            name_bytes.append(data[pos])
            pos += 1
        pos += 1
        while pos % 4 != 0:
            pos += 1
        streams[name_bytes.decode("ascii", errors="replace")] = (meta_off + st_off, st_size)

    if "#~" not in streams or "#Strings" not in streams:
        info["error"] = f"Missing #~ or #Strings stream (found: {list(streams.keys())})"
        return info

    t_off, _ = streams["#~"]
    s_off, s_size = streams["#Strings"]
    strings_blob = data[s_off : s_off + s_size]

    def get_str(idx):
        if idx >= len(strings_blob):
            return ""
        end = strings_blob.find(b"\x00", idx)
        return strings_blob[idx:end if end != -1 else len(strings_blob)].decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

    heap_sizes = data[t_off + 6]
    str_idx_sz = 4 if (heap_sizes & 0x01) else 2
    guid_idx_sz = 4 if (heap_sizes & 0x02) else 2
    blob_idx_sz = 4 if (heap_sizes & 0x04) else 2
    valid_mask = struct.unpack_from("<Q", data, t_off + 8)[0]

    row_counts = {}
    cur = t_off + 24
    for tid in range(64):
        if (valid_mask >> tid) & 1:
            row_counts[tid] = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, cur)[0]
            cur += 4

    def tbl_idx_sz(tid):
        return 4 if row_counts.get(tid, 0) >= 65536 else 2

    max_tdr = max(row_counts.get(2, 0), row_counts.get(1, 0), row_counts.get(27, 0))
    tdr_sz = 4 if (max_tdr << 2) >= 65536 else 2
    field_idx_sz = tbl_idx_sz(4)
    method_idx_sz = tbl_idx_sz(6)
    param_idx_sz = tbl_idx_sz(8)
    typedef_row_sz = 4 + str_idx_sz + str_idx_sz + tdr_sz + field_idx_sz + method_idx_sz
    field_row_sz = 2 + str_idx_sz + blob_idx_sz
    method_row_sz = 4 + 2 + 2 + str_idx_sz + blob_idx_sz + param_idx_sz

    table_starts = {}
    t_cur = cur
    for tid in range(64):
        if (valid_mask >> tid) & 1:
            table_starts[tid] = t_cur
            cnt = row_counts.get(tid, 0)
            if tid == 0:
                t_cur += cnt * (2 + str_idx_sz + guid_idx_sz * 3)
            elif tid == 1:
                max_rs = max(row_counts.get(0, 0), row_counts.get(26, 0), row_counts.get(2, 0), row_counts.get(35, 0))
                rs_sz = 4 if (max_rs << 2) >= 65536 else 2
                t_cur += cnt * (rs_sz + str_idx_sz * 2)
            elif tid == 2:
                t_cur += cnt * typedef_row_sz
            elif tid == 4:
                t_cur += cnt * field_row_sz
            elif tid == 6:
                t_cur += cnt * method_row_sz
            else:
                break

    if 2 not in table_starts or 4 not in table_starts or 6 not in table_starts:
        info["error"] = "Required metadata tables (TypeDef/Field/MethodDef) not found"
        return info

    def read_idx(off, sz):
        return struct.unpack_from("<I", data, off)[0] if sz == 4 else struct.unpack_from("<H", data, off)[0]

    td_start = table_starts[2]
    td_count = row_counts.get(2, 0)
    fl_off = 4 + str_idx_sz + str_idx_sz + tdr_sz
    ml_off = fl_off + field_idx_sz

    field_owner = {}
    for i in range(td_count):
        roff = td_start + i * typedef_row_sz
        tname = get_str(read_idx(roff + 4, str_idx_sz))
        tns = get_str(read_idx(roff + 4 + str_idx_sz, str_idx_sz))
        f_first = read_idx(roff + fl_off, field_idx_sz)
        f_last = read_idx(td_start + (i + 1) * typedef_row_sz + fl_off, field_idx_sz) if i + 1 < td_count else row_counts.get(4, 0) + 1
        for fidx in range(f_first, f_last):
            field_owner[fidx] = f"{tns}.{tname}" if tns else tname

    f_start = table_starts[4]
    f_count = row_counts.get(4, 0)
    field_tokens = {}
    for idx1 in range(1, f_count + 1):
        foff = f_start + (idx1 - 1) * field_row_sz
        fname = get_str(read_idx(foff + 2, str_idx_sz))
        owner = field_owner.get(idx1, "")
        field_tokens[0x04000000 | idx1] = f"{owner}.{fname}" if owner else fname

    m_start = table_starts[6]
    m_count = row_counts.get(6, 0)
    method_owner = {}
    for i in range(td_count):
        roff = td_start + i * typedef_row_sz
        tname = get_str(read_idx(roff + 4, str_idx_sz))
        tns = get_str(read_idx(roff + 4 + str_idx_sz, str_idx_sz))
        m_first = read_idx(roff + ml_off, method_idx_sz)
        m_last = read_idx(td_start + (i + 1) * typedef_row_sz + ml_off, method_idx_sz) if i + 1 < td_count else m_count + 1
        for midx in range(m_first, m_last):
            method_owner[midx] = f"{tns}.{tname}" if tns else tname

    method_tokens = {}
    method_entries = []
    for idx1 in range(1, m_count + 1):
        moff = m_start + (idx1 - 1) * method_row_sz
        mrva = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, moff)[0]
        mname = get_str(read_idx(moff + 8, str_idx_sz))
        owner = method_owner.get(idx1, "")
        full_m = f"{owner}.{mname}" if owner else mname
        method_tokens[0x06000000 | idx1] = full_m
        foff = rva_to_offset(mrva, sections) if mrva else None
        method_entries.append((owner, mname, full_m, mrva, foff, idx1))

    if 10 in table_starts:
        mr_start = table_starts[10]
        mr_count = row_counts.get(10, 0)
        max_mrp = max(row_counts.get(2, 0), row_counts.get(1, 0), row_counts.get(26, 0), row_counts.get(6, 0), row_counts.get(27, 0))
        mrp_sz = 4 if (max_mrp << 3) >= 65536 else 2
        mr_row_sz = mrp_sz + str_idx_sz + blob_idx_sz
        for idx1 in range(1, mr_count + 1):
            mroff = mr_start + (idx1 - 1) * mr_row_sz
            mname = get_str(read_idx(mroff + mrp_sz, str_idx_sz))
            method_tokens[0x0A000000 | idx1] = f"<MemberRef>.{mname}"

    all_fields_list = [get_str(read_idx(f_start + i * field_row_sz + 2, str_idx_sz)) for i in range(f_count)]
    all_methods_list = [get_str(read_idx(m_start + i * method_row_sz + 8, str_idx_sz)) for i in range(m_count)]

    types = []
    for i in range(td_count):
        roff = td_start + i * typedef_row_sz
        tname = get_str(read_idx(roff + 4, str_idx_sz))
        tns = get_str(read_idx(roff + 4 + str_idx_sz, str_idx_sz))
        f_first = read_idx(roff + fl_off, field_idx_sz) - 1
        m_first = read_idx(roff + ml_off, method_idx_sz) - 1
        if i + 1 < td_count:
            next_roff = td_start + (i + 1) * typedef_row_sz
            f_last = read_idx(next_roff + fl_off, field_idx_sz) - 1
            m_last = read_idx(next_roff + ml_off, method_idx_sz) - 1
        else:
            f_last, m_last = len(all_fields_list), len(all_methods_list)
        types.append({
            "namespace": tns,
            "name": tname,
            "full": f"{tns}.{tname}" if tns else tname,
            "fields": all_fields_list[max(0, f_first):max(0, f_last)],
            "methods": all_methods_list[max(0, m_first):max(0, m_last)],
        })

    info["parsed"] = True
    info["data"] = data
    info["sections_raw"] = sections
    info["types"] = types
    info["field_tokens"] = field_tokens
    info["method_tokens"] = method_tokens
    info["method_entries"] = method_entries
    return info

def extract_il_bytes(data, foff):
    if foff is None or foff < 0 or foff >= len(data):
        return None, None, None
    b0 = data[foff]
    if (b0 & 0x03) == 0x02:
        code_size = b0 >> 2
        il_start = foff + 1
        hdr = f"Tiny ({code_size}B)"
    elif (b0 & 0x07) == 0x03:
        if foff + 12 > len(data):
            return None, None, None
        _, max_stack, code_size, _ = struct.unpack_from("<HHII", data, foff)
        il_start = foff + 12
        hdr = f"Fat (stack={max_stack}, {code_size}B)"
    else:
        return f"NonIL(0x{b0:02x})", b"", b""
    il = data[il_start : il_start + code_size]
    return hdr, il, il.hex()

def trace_il_refs(il, ftok, mtok):
    refs = []
    r4s = []
    if not il:
        return refs, r4s
    for i in range(len(il) - 4):
        op = il[i]
        if op in (0x7B, 0x7C, 0x7D):
            tok = struct.unpack_from("<I", il, i + 1)[0]
            if tok in ftok:
                opname = {0x7B: "ldfld", 0x7C: "ldsfld", 0x7D: "stfld"}[op]
                refs.append(f"@{i:3d} {opname:6s} {ftok[tok]} (tok=0x{tok:08x})")
        elif op in (0x28, 0x6F):
            tok = struct.unpack_from("<I", il, i + 1)[0]
            if tok in mtok:
                opname = {0x28: "call", 0x6F: "callvirt"}[op]
                refs.append(f"@{i:3d} {opname:8s} {mtok[tok]} (tok=0x{tok:08x})")
        elif op == 0x22:
            val = struct.unpack_from("<f", il, i + 1)[0]
            if val == val and abs(val) < 1e8:
                r4s.append(f"@{i:3d} ldc.r4 {val}")
    return refs, r4s

def scan_assets_presence():
    lines = []
    keywords = [b"_Ceto", b"Ceto.Ocean", b"Tide", b"BuoyancyManager", b"WaveSpectrum", b"ProjectedGrid"]
    for fname in SCENE_FILES:
        fpath = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, fname)
        if not os.path.exists(fpath):
            fpath = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "Resources", fname)
        if not os.path.exists(fpath):
            lines.append(f"  {fname:30s} : NOT FOUND")
            continue
        sz = os.path.getsize(fpath)
        with open(fpath, "rb") as f:
            blob = f.read()
        found_kw = [kw.decode("ascii") for kw in keywords if kw in blob]
        lines.append(f"  {fname:30s} : size={sz:10d} bytes | strings_found={found_kw}")
    return lines

OP1 = {
    0x00: ("nop", None), 0x01: ("break", None), 0x02: ("ldarg.0", None), 0x03: ("ldarg.1", None),
    0x04: ("ldarg.2", None), 0x05: ("ldarg.3", None), 0x06: ("ldloc.0", None), 0x07: ("ldloc.1", None),
    0x08: ("ldloc.2", None), 0x09: ("ldloc.3", None), 0x0A: ("stloc.0", None), 0x0B: ("stloc.1", None),
    0x0C: ("stloc.2", None), 0x0D: ("stloc.3", None), 0x0E: ("ldarg.s", "u1"), 0x0F: ("ldarga.s", "u1"),
    0x10: ("starg.s", "u1"), 0x11: ("ldloc.s", "u1"), 0x12: ("ldloca.s", "u1"), 0x13: ("stloc.s", "u1"),
    0x14: ("ldnull", None), 0x15: ("ldc.i4.m1", None), 0x16: ("ldc.i4.0", None), 0x17: ("ldc.i4.1", None),
    0x18: ("ldc.i4.2", None), 0x19: ("ldc.i4.3", None), 0x1A: ("ldc.i4.4", None), 0x1B: ("ldc.i4.5", None),
    0x1C: ("ldc.i4.6", None), 0x1D: ("ldc.i4.7", None), 0x1E: ("ldc.i4.8", None), 0x1F: ("ldc.i4.s", "i1"),
    0x20: ("ldc.i4", "i4"), 0x21: ("ldc.i8", "i8"), 0x22: ("ldc.r4", "r4"), 0x23: ("ldc.r8", "r8"),
    0x25: ("dup", None), 0x26: ("pop", None), 0x28: ("call", "tok"), 0x29: ("calli", "sig"),
    0x2A: ("ret", None), 0x2B: ("br.s", "br1"), 0x2C: ("brfalse.s", "br1"), 0x2D: ("brtrue.s", "br1"),
    0x2E: ("beq.s", "br1"), 0x2F: ("bge.s", "br1"), 0x30: ("bgt.s", "br1"), 0x31: ("ble.s", "br1"),
    0x32: ("blt.s", "br1"), 0x33: ("bne.un.s", "br1"), 0x34: ("bge.un.s", "br1"), 0x35: ("bgt.un.s", "br1"),
    0x36: ("ble.un.s", "br1"), 0x37: ("blt.un.s", "br1"), 0x38: ("br", "br4"), 0x39: ("brfalse", "br4"),
    0x3A: ("brtrue", "br4"), 0x3B: ("beq", "br4"), 0x3C: ("bge", "br4"), 0x3D: ("bgt", "br4"),
    0x3E: ("ble", "br4"), 0x3F: ("blt", "br4"), 0x40: ("bne.un", "br4"), 0x41: ("bge.un", "br4"),
    0x42: ("bgt.un", "br4"), 0x43: ("ble.un", "br4"), 0x44: ("blt.un", "br4"), 0x4E: ("ldind.r4", None),
    0x4F: ("ldind.r8", None), 0x50: ("ldind.ref", None), 0x56: ("stind.r4", None), 0x57: ("stind.r8", None),
    0x58: ("add", None), 0x59: ("sub", None), 0x5A: ("mul", None), 0x5B: ("div", None),
    0x5C: ("div.un", None), 0x5D: ("rem", None), 0x5E: ("rem.un", None), 0x65: ("neg", None),
    0x6B: ("conv.r4", None), 0x6C: ("conv.r8", None), 0x6F: ("callvirt", "tok"), 0x71: ("ldobj", "tok"),
    0x72: ("ldstr", "tok"), 0x73: ("newobj", "tok"), 0x74: ("castclass", "tok"), 0x75: ("isinst", "tok"),
    0x76: ("conv.r.un", None), 0x7A: ("throw", None), 0x7B: ("ldfld", "tok"), 0x7C: ("ldsfld", "tok"),
    0x7D: ("stfld", "tok"), 0x7E: ("stsfld", "tok"), 0x7F: ("ldobj", "tok"), 0x80: ("stobj", "tok"),
    0x8C: ("newarr", "tok"), 0x8D: ("ldlen", None), 0x8E: ("ldelema", "tok"), 0x8F: ("ldelem.i1", None),
    0x90: ("ldelem.u1", None), 0x91: ("ldelem.i2", None), 0x92: ("ldelem.u2", None), 0x93: ("ldelem.i4", None),
    0x97: ("ldelem.r4", None), 0x98: ("ldelem.r8", None), 0x99: ("ldelem.ref", None), 0x9A: ("stelem.i", None),

OP2 = {
    0x00: ("ceq", None), 0x01: ("cgt", None), 0x02: ("cgt.un", None), 0x03: ("clt", None),
    0x04: ("clt.un", None), 0x05: ("ldftn", "tok"), 0x06: ("ldvirtftn", "tok"), 0x09: ("ldarg", "u2"),
    0x0A: ("ldarga", "u2"), 0x0B: ("starg", "u2"), 0x0C: ("ldloc", "u2"), 0x0D: ("ldloca", "u2"),
    0x0E: ("stloc", "u2"), 0x15: ("initobj", "tok"), 0x16: ("constrained.", "tok"),
}

def rva_to_offset(rva, sections):
    for vaddr, vsize, raw_ptr, raw_size in sections:
        if vaddr <= rva < vaddr + max(vsize, raw_size):
            return raw_ptr + (rva - vaddr)
    return None

def parse_pe(path):
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return {"exists": False, "path": path}
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()

    info = {"exists": True, "path": path, "size": len(data), "parsed": False, "error": None}
    e_lfanew = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, 0x3C)[0]
    if e_lfanew + 24 > len(data) or data[e_lfanew:e_lfanew+4] != b"PE\x00\x00":
        info["error"] = "Invalid PE header"
        return info

    num_sections = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, e_lfanew + 6)[0]
    opt_hdr_size = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, e_lfanew + 20)[0]
    opt_off = e_lfanew + 24
    magic = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, opt_off)[0]
    dd_off = opt_off + (96 if magic == 0x10B else 112)
    cli_rva, _ = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, dd_off + 14 * 8)

    sec_off = opt_off + opt_hdr_size
    sections = []
    sec_rows = []
    for i in range(num_sections):
        s = data[sec_off + i*40 : sec_off + (i+1)*40]
        sname = s[:8].rstrip(b"\x00").decode("ascii", errors="replace")
        vsize, vaddr, raw_size, raw_ptr = struct.unpack_from("<IIII", s, 8)
        sections.append((vaddr, vsize, raw_ptr, raw_size))
        sec_rows.append((sname, vaddr, vsize, raw_ptr, raw_size))

    cli_off = rva_to_offset(cli_rva, sections)
    if not cli_off or cli_off + 16 > len(data):
        info["error"] = "Invalid CLI header"
        return info

    meta_rva, _ = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, cli_off + 8)
    meta_off = rva_to_offset(meta_rva, sections)
    if not meta_off or meta_off + 16 > len(data) or data[meta_off:meta_off+4] != b"BSJB":
        info["error"] = "Invalid BSJB metadata"
        return info

    ver_len = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, meta_off + 12)[0]
    pos = meta_off + 16 + ver_len
    while pos % 4 != 0:
        pos += 1
    num_streams = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, pos + 2)[0]
    pos += 4

    streams = {}
    for _ in range(num_streams):
        st_off, st_size = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, pos)
        pos += 8
        name_bytes = bytearray()
        while pos < len(data) and data[pos] != 0:
            name_bytes.append(data[pos])
            pos += 1
        pos += 1
        while pos % 4 != 0:
            pos += 1
        streams[name_bytes.decode("ascii", errors="replace")] = (meta_off + st_off, st_size)

    if "#~" not in streams or "#Strings" not in streams:
        info["error"] = "Missing #~ or #Strings stream"
        return info

    t_off, _ = streams["#~"]
    s_off, s_size = streams["#Strings"]
    strings_blob = data[s_off : s_off + s_size]
    us_off, us_size = streams.get("#US", (0, 0))
    us_blob = data[us_off : us_off + us_size] if us_size else b""

    def get_str(idx):
        if idx >= len(strings_blob):
            return ""
        end = strings_blob.find(b"\x00", idx)
        return strings_blob[idx:end if end != -1 else len(strings_blob)].decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

    def get_us(idx):
        if not us_blob or idx + 1 >= len(us_blob):
            return ""
        b0 = us_blob[idx]
        if b0 < 0x80:
            ln, start = b0, idx + 1
        elif (b0 & 0xC0) == 0x80 and idx + 2 < len(us_blob):
            ln, start = ((b0 & 0x3F) << 8) | us_blob[idx + 1], idx + 2
        else:
            return ""
        return us_blob[start : start + max(0, ln - 1)].decode("utf-16-le", errors="replace")

    heap_sizes = data[t_off + 6]
    str_idx_sz = 4 if (heap_sizes & 0x01) else 2
    guid_idx_sz = 4 if (heap_sizes & 0x02) else 2
    blob_idx_sz = 4 if (heap_sizes & 0x04) else 2
    valid_mask = struct.unpack_from("<Q", data, t_off + 8)[0]

    row_counts = {}
    cur = t_off + 24
    for tid in range(64):
        if (valid_mask >> tid) & 1:
            row_counts[tid] = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, cur)[0]
            cur += 4

    def tbl_idx_sz(tid):
        return 4 if row_counts.get(tid, 0) >= 65536 else 2

    max_tdr = max(row_counts.get(2, 0), row_counts.get(1, 0), row_counts.get(27, 0))
    tdr_sz = 4 if (max_tdr << 2) >= 65536 else 2
    field_idx_sz = tbl_idx_sz(4)
    method_idx_sz = tbl_idx_sz(6)
    param_idx_sz = tbl_idx_sz(8)
    typedef_row_sz = 4 + str_idx_sz + str_idx_sz + tdr_sz + field_idx_sz + method_idx_sz
    field_row_sz = 2 + str_idx_sz + blob_idx_sz
    method_row_sz = 4 + 2 + 2 + str_idx_sz + blob_idx_sz + param_idx_sz

    table_starts = {}
    t_cur = cur
    for tid in range(64):
        if (valid_mask >> tid) & 1:
            table_starts[tid] = t_cur
            cnt = row_counts.get(tid, 0)
            if tid == 0:
                t_cur += cnt * (2 + str_idx_sz + guid_idx_sz * 3)
            elif tid == 1:
                max_rs = max(row_counts.get(0, 0), row_counts.get(26, 0), row_counts.get(2, 0), row_counts.get(35, 0))
                rs_sz = 4 if (max_rs << 2) >= 65536 else 2
                t_cur += cnt * (rs_sz + str_idx_sz * 2)
            elif tid == 2:
                t_cur += cnt * typedef_row_sz
            elif tid == 4:
                t_cur += cnt * field_row_sz
            elif tid == 6:
                t_cur += cnt * method_row_sz
            else:
                break

    def read_idx(off, sz):
        return struct.unpack_from("<I", data, off)[0] if sz == 4 else struct.unpack_from("<H", data, off)[0]

    td_start = table_starts[2]
    td_count = row_counts.get(2, 0)
    fl_off = 4 + str_idx_sz + str_idx_sz + tdr_sz
    ml_off = fl_off + field_idx_sz

    field_owner = {}
    for i in range(td_count):
        roff = td_start + i * typedef_row_sz
        tname = get_str(read_idx(roff + 4, str_idx_sz))
        tns = get_str(read_idx(roff + 4 + str_idx_sz, str_idx_sz))
        f_first = read_idx(roff + fl_off, field_idx_sz)
        f_last = read_idx(td_start + (i + 1) * typedef_row_sz + fl_off, field_idx_sz) if i + 1 < td_count else row_counts.get(4, 0) + 1
        for fidx in range(f_first, f_last):
            field_owner[fidx] = f"{tns}.{tname}" if tns else tname

    f_start = table_starts[4]
    f_count = row_counts.get(4, 0)
    tokens = {}
    for idx1 in range(1, f_count + 1):
        foff = f_start + (idx1 - 1) * field_row_sz
        fname = get_str(read_idx(foff + 2, str_idx_sz))
        owner = field_owner.get(idx1, "")
        tokens[0x04000000 | idx1] = f"{owner}.{fname}" if owner else fname

    m_start = table_starts[6]
    m_count = row_counts.get(6, 0)
    method_owner = {}
    for i in range(td_count):
        roff = td_start + i * typedef_row_sz
        tname = get_str(read_idx(roff + 4, str_idx_sz))
        tns = get_str(read_idx(roff + 4 + str_idx_sz, str_idx_sz))
        m_first = read_idx(roff + ml_off, method_idx_sz)
        m_last = read_idx(td_start + (i + 1) * typedef_row_sz + ml_off, method_idx_sz) if i + 1 < td_count else m_count + 1
        for midx in range(m_first, m_last):
            method_owner[midx] = f"{tns}.{tname}" if tns else tname

    method_entries = []
    for idx1 in range(1, m_count + 1):
        moff = m_start + (idx1 - 1) * method_row_sz
        mrva = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, moff)[0]
        mname = get_str(read_idx(moff + 8, str_idx_sz))
        owner = method_owner.get(idx1, "")
        full_m = f"{owner}.{mname}" if owner else mname
        tokens[0x06000000 | idx1] = full_m
        foff = rva_to_offset(mrva, sections) if mrva else None
        method_entries.append((owner, mname, full_m, mrva, foff, idx1))

    if 10 in table_starts:
        mr_start = table_starts[10]
        mr_count = row_counts.get(10, 0)
        max_mrp = max(row_counts.get(2, 0), row_counts.get(1, 0), row_counts.get(26, 0), row_counts.get(6, 0), row_counts.get(27, 0))
        mrp_sz = 4 if (max_mrp << 3) >= 65536 else 2
        mr_row_sz = mrp_sz + str_idx_sz + blob_idx_sz
        for idx1 in range(1, mr_count + 1):
            mroff = mr_start + (idx1 - 1) * mr_row_sz
            mname = get_str(read_idx(mroff + mrp_sz, str_idx_sz))
            tokens[0x0A000000 | idx1] = f"<MemberRef>.{mname}"

    all_fields = [get_str(read_idx(f_start + i * field_row_sz + 2, str_idx_sz)) for i in range(f_count)]
    all_methods = [get_str(read_idx(m_start + i * method_row_sz + 8, str_idx_sz)) for i in range(m_count)]

    types = []
    for i in range(td_count):
        roff = td_start + i * typedef_row_sz
        tname = get_str(read_idx(roff + 4, str_idx_sz))
        tns = get_str(read_idx(roff + 4 + str_idx_sz, str_idx_sz))
        f_first = read_idx(roff + fl_off, field_idx_sz) - 1
        m_first = read_idx(roff + ml_off, method_idx_sz) - 1
        if i + 1 < td_count:
            next_roff = td_start + (i + 1) * typedef_row_sz
            f_last = read_idx(next_roff + fl_off, field_idx_sz) - 1
            m_last = read_idx(next_roff + ml_off, method_idx_sz) - 1
        else:
            f_last, m_last = len(all_fields), len(all_methods)
        types.append({
            "full": f"{tns}.{tname}" if tns else tname,
            "fields": all_fields[max(0, f_first):max(0, f_last)],
            "methods": all_methods[max(0, m_first):max(0, m_last)],
        })

    info.update({
        "parsed": True,
        "data": data,
        "sections": sec_rows,
        "types": types,
        "tokens": tokens,
        "get_us": get_us,
        "method_entries": method_entries,
    })
    return info

def get_il_slice(data, foff):
    if not foff or foff < 0 or foff >= len(data):
        return "InvalidOffset", b""
    b0 = data[foff]
    if (b0 & 0x03) == 0x02:
        code_size = b0 >> 2
        return f"Tiny ({code_size}B)", data[foff + 1 : foff + 1 + code_size]
    elif (b0 & 0x07) == 0x03:
        if foff + 12 > len(data):
            return "TruncatedFat", b""
        _, max_stack, code_size, _ = struct.unpack_from("<HHII", data, foff)
        return f"Fat (stack={max_stack}, {code_size}B)", data[foff + 12 : foff + 12 + code_size]
    return f"NonIL(0x{b0:02x})", b""

def disasm_full(il, tokens, get_us):
    lines = []
    ip, n = 0, len(il)
    while ip < n:
        start_ip = ip
        op = il[ip]
        ip += 1
        if op == 0xFE and ip < n:
            op2 = il[ip]
            ip += 1
            mnem, otype = OP2.get(op2, (f"fe.{op2:02x}", None))
        else:
            mnem, otype = OP1.get(op, (f"op_{op:02x}", None))

        arg_str = ""
        if otype == "i1" and ip < n:
            arg_str = str(struct.unpack_from("<b", il, ip)[0]); ip += 1
        elif otype == "u1" and ip < n:
            arg_str = str(il[ip]); ip += 1
        elif otype == "i2" and ip + 2 <= n:
            arg_str = str(struct.unpack_from("<h", il, ip)[0]); ip += 2
        elif otype == "i4" and ip + 4 <= n:
            arg_str = str(struct.unpack_from("<i", il, ip)[0]); ip += 4
        elif otype == "i8" and ip + 8 <= n:
            arg_str = str(struct.unpack_from("<q", il, ip)[0]); ip += 8
        elif otype == "r4" and ip + 4 <= n:
            arg_str = f"{struct.unpack_from('<f', il, ip)[0]:g}"; ip += 4
        elif otype == "r8" and ip + 8 <= n:
            arg_str = f"{struct.unpack_from('<d', il, ip)[0]:g}"; ip += 8
        elif otype == "br1" and ip < n:
            delta = struct.unpack_from("<b", il, ip)[0]; ip += 1
            arg_str = f"IL_{ip + delta:04d}"
        elif otype == "br4" and ip + 4 <= n:
            delta = struct.unpack_from("<i", il, ip)[0]; ip += 4
            arg_str = f"IL_{ip + delta:04d}"
        elif otype == "tok" and ip + 4 <= n:
            tok = struct.unpack_from("<I", il, ip)[0]; ip += 4
            if (tok >> 24) == 0x70:
                arg_str = f'"{get_us(tok & 0x00FFFFFF)}" (0x{tok:08x})'
            else:
                arg_str = f"{tokens.get(tok, f'tok_0x{tok:08x}')} (0x{tok:08x})"
        elif otype == "sig" and ip + 4 <= n:
            tok = struct.unpack_from("<I", il, ip)[0]; ip += 4
            arg_str = f"sig_0x{tok:08x}"

        lines.append(f"  IL_{start_ip:04d}: {mnem:14s} {arg_str}".rstrip())
    return lines

def main():
    out = []
    out.append("=" * 88)
    out.append("STRANDED DEEP - COMPLETE FULL EVIDENCE REPORT (V2)")
    out.append("=" * 88)
    out.append(f"Generated At : {datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds')}")
    out.append(f"Data Dir     : {DATA_DIR}")
    out.append(f"Managed Dir  : {MANAGED_DIR}")
    out.append("")

    out.append("[1] SCENE & ASSET EVIDENCE")
    out.append("-" * 88)
    keywords = [b"_Ceto", b"Ceto.Ocean", b"Tide", b"BuoyancyManager", b"WaveSpectrum", b"ProjectedGrid"]
    for fname in SCENE_FILES:
        fpath = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, fname)
        if not os.path.exists(fpath):
            fpath = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "Resources", fname)
        if not os.path.exists(fpath):
            out.append(f"  {fname:30s} : NOT FOUND")
            continue
        with open(fpath, "rb") as f:
            blob = f.read()
        found = [k.decode("ascii") for k in keywords if k in blob]
        out.append(f"  {fname:30s} : {len(blob):10d} bytes | found={found}")
    out.append("")

    pe_main = parse_pe(DLL_MAIN)
    pe_fp = parse_pe(DLL_FIRSTPASS)
    for label, pe in [("Assembly-CSharp.dll", pe_main), ("Assembly-CSharp-firstpass.dll", pe_fp)]:
        out.append(f"Assembly: {label} | exists={pe.get('exists')} | size={pe.get('size', 0)}B | parsed={pe.get('parsed')}")
        if pe.get("error"):
            out.append(f"  Error: {pe['error']}")
        if pe.get("sections"):
            out.append("  Sections: " + ", ".join([f"{n}[va=0x{va:x},raw=0x{rp:x},sz=0x{rs:x}]" for n, va, vs, rp, rs in pe["sections"]]))
    out.append("")

    if pe_main.get("parsed"):
        data = pe_main["data"]
        tokens = pe_main["tokens"]
        get_us = pe_main["get_us"]

        target_types = {
            ".Tide", "Ceto.Ocean", "Ceto.WaveQuery", "Ceto.QueryGridScaling",
            "Ceto.QueryDisplacements", "Ceto.DisplacementBufferCPU",
            "Ceto.DisplacementBufferGPU", "Ceto.WaveSpectrum",
            "Ceto.ProjectedGrid", "Beam.CetoSettings", "Beam.BuoyancyManager",
            "Ceto.Buoyancy", ".SimpleBuoyancy"
        }
        out.append("[2] TYPE DEFINITIONS, FIELDS & METHODS")
        out.append("-" * 88)
        for t in pe_main["types"]:
            if t["full"] in target_types:
                out.append(f"Type: {t['full']}")
                out.append(f"  Fields  ({len(t['fields'])}): {t['fields']}")
                out.append(f"  Methods ({len(t['methods'])}): {t['methods']}")
        out.append("")

        full_disasm_methods = {
            ".Tide.Update",
            "Ceto.Ocean.SetQueryWavesSampling",
            "Ceto.Ocean.QueryWaves",
            "Ceto.Ocean.QueryWavesWithAsyncTask",
            "Ceto.QueryGridScaling..ctor",
            "Ceto.DisplacementBufferCPU.QueryWaves",
            "Ceto.DisplacementBufferGPU.QueryWaves",
            "Ceto.QueryDisplacements.QueryWaves",
            "Ceto.QueryDisplacements.SampleHeightOnly",
            "Ceto.QueryDisplacements.Sample",
            "Ceto.WaveSpectrum.UpdateQueryScaling",
            "Ceto.WaveSpectrum.FindRanges",
            "Ceto.WaveSpectrum.QueryWaves",
            "Beam.BuoyancyManager.DoQueries",
        }
        out.append("[3] FULL INSTRUCTION-BY-INSTRUCTION CIL DISASSEMBLY")
        out.append("-" * 88)
        for owner, mname, full_m, mrva, foff, idx1 in pe_main["method_entries"]:
            if full_m in full_disasm_methods:
                hdr, il = get_il_slice(data, foff)
                out.append(f"\n>>> {full_m} (row#{idx1}) | RVA=0x{mrva:08x} | FileOff=0x{foff:x} | {hdr}")
                out.append(f"    RawHex: {il.hex()}")
                out.extend(disasm_full(il, tokens, get_us))
        out.append("")

        ocean_level_toks = {tok for tok, nm in tokens.items() if nm == "Ceto.Ocean.level"}
        out.append("[4] ALL REFERENCES TO Ceto.Ocean.level")
        out.append("-" * 88)
        for owner, mname, full_m, mrva, foff, idx1 in pe_main["method_entries"]:
            _, il = get_il_slice(data, foff)
            if not il:
                continue
            for i in range(len(il) - 4):
                if il[i] in (0x7B, 0x7C, 0x7D):
                    tok = struct.unpack_from("<I", il, i + 1)[0]
                    if tok in ocean_level_toks:
                        opn = {0x7B: "ldfld", 0x7C: "ldsfld", 0x7D: "stfld"}[il[i]]
                        out.append(f"  {full_m:48s} @IL+{i:3d} (FileOff=0x{foff:x}): {opn} Ceto.Ocean.level")
        out.append("")

    out.append("=" * 88)
    out.append("END OF FULL EVIDENCE REPORT V2")
    out.append("=" * 88)

    with open(OUT_TXT, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(out) + "\n")
    print(f"Saved: {OUT_TXT} ({os.path.getsize(OUT_TXT)} bytes)")

    main()
