def compute_sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(65536), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def is_protected_path(path: Path) -> bool:
    return any(part in PROTECTED_DIR_NAMES for part in path.parts)


def resolve_paths_and_discover(
    base_dir: Path,
    data_dir: Path,
    extra_roots: List[Path],
) -> Dict:
    path_resolution_errors: List[Dict] = []
    missing_files: List[Dict] = []
    duplicate_candidates: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
    scanned_directories: List[str] = []
    selected_files: Dict[str, Dict] = {}

    # 1. Separate BASE_DIR and DATA_DIR responsibilities
    resolved_base: Optional[Path] = None
    resolved_data: Optional[Path] = None

    try:
        resolved_base = base_dir.resolve(strict=True)
    except Exception as exc:
        path_resolution_errors.append({
            "role": "BASE_DIR",
            "configured_path": str(base_dir),
            "error": str(exc),
        })

    try:
        resolved_data = data_dir.resolve(strict=True)
    except Exception as exc:
        path_resolution_errors.append({
            "role": "DATA_DIR",
            "configured_path": str(data_dir),
            "error": str(exc),
        })

    candidate_dirs: List[Tuple[str, Path]] = []
    if resolved_base is not None:
        candidate_dirs.append(("BASE_DIR", resolved_base))
    if resolved_data is not None:
        candidate_dirs.append(("DATA_DIR", resolved_data))
    for idx, extra in enumerate(extra_roots):
        try:
            r_extra = extra.resolve(strict=True)
            candidate_dirs.append((f"EXTRA_ROOT[{idx}]", r_extra))
        except Exception as exc:
            path_resolution_errors.append({
                "role": f"EXTRA_ROOT[{idx}]",
                "configured_path": str(extra),
                "error": str(exc),
            })

    # Scan directories (skipping protected folders like Google Ai Core V1)
    seen_dirs: Set[Path] = set()
    all_matches_by_name: Dict[str, List[Tuple[str, Path]]] = {name: [] for name in TARGET_INPUT_FILES}

    for role, dpath in candidate_dirs:
        if dpath in seen_dirs:
            continue
        seen_dirs.add(dpath)
        scanned_directories.append(f"{role}:{dpath}")

        if not dpath.is_dir():
            path_resolution_errors.append({
                "role": role,
                "path": str(dpath),
                "error": "Target directory path is not a directory",
            })
            continue

        for entry in sorted(dpath.iterdir(), key=lambda p: p.name):
            if is_protected_path(entry):
                continue
            if entry.is_file() and entry.name in all_matches_by_name:
                try:
                    abs_p = entry.resolve(strict=True)
                    all_matches_by_name[entry.name].append((role, abs_p))
                except Exception as exc:
                    path_resolution_errors.append({
                        "role": role,
                        "path": str(entry),
                        "error": f"Failed to resolve file: {exc}",
                    })

    # Detect duplicates across different directories and select intended files
    for fname in TARGET_INPUT_FILES:
        matches = all_matches_by_name[fname]
        if len(matches) > 1:
            duplicate_candidates[fname] = [f"{r}:{str(p)}" for r, p in matches]

        if not matches:
            missing_files.append({
                "filename": fname,
                "status": "MISSING",
                "reason": "File not found in scanned directories (not treated as empty input)",
            })
        else:
            # Prefer BASE_DIR match if available, otherwise first resolved match
            chosen_role, chosen_path = matches[0]
            for r, p in matches:
                if r == "BASE_DIR":
                    chosen_role, chosen_path = r, p
                    break

            stat_info = chosen_path.stat()
            selected_files[fname] = {
                "selected_role": chosen_role,
                "resolved_path": str(chosen_path),
                "size_bytes": stat_info.st_size,
                "modified_utc": dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(stat_info.st_mtime, tz=dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                "sha256": compute_sha256(chosen_path),
                "duplicate_count": len(matches),
            }

    return {
        "resolved_base_dir": str(resolved_base) if resolved_base else None,
        "resolved_data_dir": str(resolved_data) if resolved_data else None,
        "scanned_directories": scanned_directories,
        "path_resolution_errors": path_resolution_errors,
        "missing_files": missing_files,
        "duplicate_filenames": duplicate_candidates,
        "selected_files": selected_files,
    }


def parse_methods_and_tokens(text: str) -> Dict:
    # Extract all 0x06xxxxxx method tokens and occurrences
    all_token_matches = re.findall(r"\b0x06[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}\b", text)
    normalized_tokens = [t.upper().replace("0X", "0x") for t in all_token_matches]
    unique_tokens: Set[str] = set(normalized_tokens)

    # Extract declared method blocks / SIZE attributes if present in dump text
    # Example patterns: "TOKEN: 0x06002F8D", "SIZE: 951B", "TYPE: ... | METHOD: ... | TOKEN: 0x06..."
    method_records: List[Dict] = []
    block_pattern = re.compile(
        r"(?:TYPE:\s*([^\r\n|]+?)\s*\|\s*)?METHOD:\s*([^\r\n|]+?)\s*\|[^\r\n]*?TOKEN:\s*(0x06[0-9A-Fa-f]{6})[^\r\n]*?(?:SIZE:\s*(\d+)\s*B)?",
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    for m in block_pattern.finditer(text):
        m_type = (m.group(1) or "").strip()
        m_name = (m.group(2) or "").strip()
        m_tok = m.group(3).upper().replace("0X", "0x")
        m_size = int(m.group(4)) if m.group(4) else None
        full_key = f"{m_type}.{m_name}".strip(".") if m_type else m_name
        method_records.append({
            "key": full_key,
            "method": m_name,
            "token": m_tok,
            "size_bytes": m_size,
        })

    # Fallback size extraction like "QueryDisplacements.QueryWaves (951B)"
    inline_size_pattern = re.compile(r"\b([A-Za-z0-9_.]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_.]+)\b[^\r\n]{0,40}?\b(\d{1,6})\s*B\b")
    for m in inline_size_pattern.finditer(text):
        key = m.group(1).strip()
        sz = int(m.group(2))
        method_records.append({
            "key": key,
            "method": key.split(".")[-1],
            "token": None,
            "size_bytes": sz,
        })

    return {
        "total_token_occurrences": len(normalized_tokens),
        "unique_tokens": sorted(unique_tokens),
        "method_records": method_records,
    }


def verify_tokens_and_sizes(selected_files: Dict[str, Dict]) -> Dict:
    per_file_results: Dict[str, Dict] = {}
    expected_token_set = {k: v.upper().replace("0X", "0x") for k, v in VERIFIED_TOKENS.items()}
    expected_values_set = set(expected_token_set.values())

    for fname, meta in selected_files.items():
        p = Path(meta["resolved_path"])
        if not p.exists():
            continue
        text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        parsed = parse_methods_and_tokens(text)
        found_set = set(parsed["unique_tokens"])

        # Token counts & duplicates in raw stream
        occ_counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
        for tok in re.findall(r"\b0x06[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}\b", text):
            nt = tok.upper().replace("0X", "0x")
            occ_counts[nt] = occ_counts.get(nt, 0) + 1

        # Compare against VERIFIED_TOKENS
        missing_expected = {
            name: tok for name, tok in expected_token_set.items() if tok not in found_set
        }
        additional_tokens = sorted(found_set - expected_values_set)
        matched_expected = {
            name: tok for name, tok in expected_token_set.items() if tok in found_set
        }

        # Check method body sizes against METHOD_BODY_SIZES
        observed_sizes: Dict[str, List[int]] = {}
        for rec in parsed["method_records"]:
            if rec["size_bytes"] is not None:
                observed_sizes.setdefault(rec["key"], []).append(rec["size_bytes"])
                observed_sizes.setdefault(rec["method"], []).append(rec["size_bytes"])

        size_checks: List[Dict] = []
        for target_method, expected_sz in METHOD_BODY_SIZES.items():
            short_name = target_method.split(".")[-1]
            obs_list = observed_sizes.get(target_method) or observed_sizes.get(short_name) or []
            if not obs_list:
                size_checks.append({
                    "method": target_method,
                    "expected_bytes": expected_sz,
                    "observed_bytes": None,
                    "status": "UNVERIFIED",
                    "reason": "No explicit byte-size record parsed for method in this file",
                })
            else:
                matches_exact = [s for s in obs_list if s == expected_sz]
                mismatches = [s for s in obs_list if s != expected_sz]
                size_checks.append({
                    "method": target_method,
                    "expected_bytes": expected_sz,
                    "observed_bytes": obs_list,
                    "matched_count": len(matches_exact),
                    "mismatched_values": mismatches,
                    "status": "VERIFIED" if (matches_exact and not mismatches) else ("PARTIALLY VERIFIED" if matches_exact else "FAIL"),
                })

        # Detect mismatched method->token associations if explicitly paired in records
        mismatched_pairs: List[Dict] = []
        for rec in parsed["method_records"]:
            if rec["token"] and rec["key"] in expected_token_set:
                exp_t = expected_token_set[rec["key"]]
                if rec["token"] != exp_t:
                    mismatched_pairs.append({
                        "method": rec["key"],
                        "expected_token": exp_t,
                        "observed_token": rec["token"],
                    })

        # Repeated method keys in records
        rec_key_counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
        for rec in parsed["method_records"]:
            if rec["key"]:
                rec_key_counts[rec["key"]] = rec_key_counts.get(rec["key"], 0) + 1
        duplicate_method_records = {k: c for k, c in rec_key_counts.items() if c > 1}

        per_file_results[fname] = {
            "unique_token_count": len(found_set),
            "total_token_occurrences": parsed["total_token_occurrences"],
            "matched_expected_tokens": matched_expected,
            "missing_expected_tokens": missing_expected,
            "additional_tokens_count": len(additional_tokens),
            "additional_tokens_sample": additional_tokens[:25],
            "duplicate_method_records": duplicate_method_records,
            "mismatched_method_token_pairs": mismatched_pairs,
            "method_size_checks": size_checks,
        }

    return per_file_results


def validate_combined_evidence(selected_files: Dict[str, Dict], token_results: Dict[str, Dict]) -> Dict:
    has_core = CORE_FILENAME in selected_files
    has_pipe = PIPE_FILENAME in selected_files
    has_comb = COMB_FILENAME in selected_files

    if not (has_core and has_pipe and has_comb):
        present = [n for n in (CORE_FILENAME, PIPE_FILENAME, COMB_FILENAME) if n in selected_files]
        missing = [n for n in (CORE_FILENAME, PIPE_FILENAME, COMB_FILENAME) if n not in selected_files]
        return {
            "status": "UNVERIFIED",
            "verdict": "MISSING_INPUTS",
            "is_independent_source": False,
            "present_files": present,
            "missing_files": missing,
            "reason": "Cannot verify exact/partial union until 1_OCEAN_CORE_PART_01.txt, 2_GPU_CPU_PIPELINE_PART_01.txt, and 3_COMBINED_OCEAN_GPU_CPU_PART_01.txt are all present.",
        }

    core_text = Path(selected_files[CORE_FILENAME]["resolved_path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    pipe_text = Path(selected_files[PIPE_FILENAME]["resolved_path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    comb_text = Path(selected_files[COMB_FILENAME]["resolved_path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

    core_parsed = parse_methods_and_tokens(core_text)
    pipe_parsed = parse_methods_and_tokens(pipe_text)
    comb_parsed = parse_methods_and_tokens(comb_text)

    core_toks = set(core_parsed["unique_tokens"])
    pipe_toks = set(pipe_parsed["unique_tokens"])
    comb_toks = set(comb_parsed["unique_tokens"])

    union_toks = core_toks | pipe_toks
    missing_from_comb = sorted(union_toks - comb_toks)
    extra_in_comb = sorted(comb_toks - union_toks)
    overlap_core_pipe = sorted(core_toks & pipe_toks)

    core_keys = {r["key"] for r in core_parsed["method_records"] if r["key"]}
    pipe_keys = {r["key"] for r in pipe_parsed["method_records"] if r["key"]}
    comb_keys = {r["key"] for r in comb_parsed["method_records"] if r["key"]}
    union_keys = core_keys | pipe_keys

    missing_keys_in_comb = sorted(union_keys - comb_keys)
    extra_keys_in_comb = sorted(comb_keys - union_keys)

    if not missing_from_comb and not extra_in_comb and not missing_keys_in_comb and not extra_keys_in_comb:
        union_classification = "EXACT_UNION"
        status = "VERIFIED"
    elif extra_in_comb or extra_keys_in_comb:
        union_classification = "CONFLICTING_OR_EXTRA_CONTENT"
        status = "PARTIALLY VERIFIED"
    else:
        union_classification = "PARTIAL_UNION"
        status = "PARTIALLY VERIFIED"

    return {
        "status": status,
        "classification": union_classification,
        "is_independent_source": False,
        "independence_note": "Combined file is evaluated strictly as a merged representation of CORE and PIPE, never as an independent source.",
        "core_unique_tokens": len(core_toks),
        "pipe_unique_tokens": len(pipe_toks),
        "combined_unique_tokens": len(comb_toks),
        "union_unique_tokens": len(union_toks),
        "overlap_core_and_pipe_tokens": overlap_core_pipe,
        "missing_tokens_in_combined": missing_from_comb,
        "extra_tokens_in_combined": extra_in_comb,
        "missing_method_keys_in_combined": missing_keys_in_comb,
        "extra_method_keys_in_combined": extra_keys_in_comb,
    }


def evaluate_technical_claims(selected_files: Dict[str, Dict], token_results: Dict[str, Dict], combined_eval: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
    # Evaluates status strictly from observed evidence in selected files
    any_dump_present = any(
        k in selected_files
        for k in (
            CORE_FILENAME,
            PIPE_FILENAME,
            COMB_FILENAME,
            "DISPLACEMENT_GENERATION_PIPELINE_FINAL.txt",
            "DISPLACEMENT_OUTPUT_STRUCTURE_REPORT.txt",
            "VERIFY_SUBMISSION_REPORT.txt",
            "VERIFY_SUBMISSION_REPORT_V2.txt",
        )
    )

    # Check if '0x06003091' (ReadFromGPU) and '0x06003090' (GenerateDisplacement) appear in any loaded file
    found_all_tokens: Set[str] = set()
    for res in token_results.values():
        found_all_tokens.update(res.get("matched_expected_tokens", {}).values())

    has_0x06003091 = "0x06003091" in found_all_tokens
    has_0x06003090 = "0x06003090" in found_all_tokens
    has_0x06002F78 = "0x06002F78" in found_all_tokens
    has_0x06002F7B = "0x06002F7B" in found_all_tokens
    has_0x06002F8F = "0x06002F8F" in found_all_tokens

    return [
        {
            "id": "GRID3_READBACK_OBSERVATION",
            "observed_behavior": "In Ceto.WaveSpectrum.ReadFromGPU (0x06003091), readback calls are observed for Grids 0..2 with no corresponding readback call for Grid 3 in the audited IL summary.",
            "status": "VERIFIED" if has_0x06003091 else "UNVERIFIED",
            "outcome": "PASS" if has_0x06003091 else "FAIL (MISSING_INPUT_EVIDENCE)",
        },
        {
            "id": "GRID3_SKIP_REASON_BANDWIDTH",
            "observed_behavior": "No hardcoded bandwidth-saving claim is asserted as verified fact; why Grid 3 is omitted from CPU readback is separated from observed IL instructions.",
            "status": "UNVERIFIED",
            "inferred_hypothesis": "Saving GPU-to-CPU readback transfer cost for Grid 3 is an unverified inference unless directly proven by source/comments/constants.",
            "outcome": "PARTIAL / UNVERIFIED",
        },
        {
            "id": "GRID3_TEXTURE_BINDING_AND_SHADER_CONSUMPTION",
            "observed_behavior": "GenerateDisplacement (0x06003090) binds Ceto_DisplacementMap0..3; actual shader sampling of Grid 3 and CPU query data validity when sampleSpectrum[3] is enabled are not yet proven end-to-end.",
            "status": "PARTIALLY VERIFIED" if has_0x06003090 else "UNVERIFIED",
            "outcome": "PARTIAL",
        },
        {
            "id": "CPU_BUFFER_SWAP_ORDER",
            "observed_behavior": "DisplacementBufferCPU.Run (0x06002F78) invokes SwapDisplacements (0x06002F7B) prior to spectrum/FFT task execution; task completion / caller ordering risks remain a subject of verification.",
            "status": "PARTIALLY VERIFIED" if (has_0x06002F78 and has_0x06002F7B) else "UNVERIFIED",
            "outcome": "PARTIAL",
        },
        {
            "id": "COMBINED_UNION_VALIDATION",
            "observed_behavior": combined_eval.get("classification", "UNVERIFIED"),
            "status": combined_eval.get("status", "UNVERIFIED"),
            "outcome": "PASS" if combined_eval.get("classification") == "EXACT_UNION" else ("PARTIAL" if any_dump_present else "FAIL (MISSING_INPUTS)"),
        },
        {
            "id": "SAMPLING_AND_CLAMP_PIPELINE",
            "observed_behavior": "QueryDisplacements.Sample (0x06002F8F) and SampleHeightOnly (0x06002F8E) scaling, iteration, and [-40.0f, 40.0f] height clamp.",
            "status": "PARTIALLY VERIFIED" if has_0x06002F8F else "UNVERIFIED",
            "outcome": "PARTIAL" if has_0x06002F8F else "UNVERIFIED",
        },
    ]


def generate_report_text(manifest: Dict) -> str:
    lines: List[str] = []
    lines.append("=" * 78)
    lines.append("GEMINI AI CORE 1 — REPRODUCIBLE FORENSIC AUDIT REPORT")
    lines.append(f"Scan Timestamp (UTC) : {manifest['scan_timestamp_utc']}")
    lines.append(f"Resolved BASE_DIR    : {manifest['discovery']['resolved_base_dir']}")
    lines.append(f"Resolved DATA_DIR    : {manifest['discovery']['resolved_data_dir']}")
    lines.append("=" * 78)
    lines.append("")

    lines.append("[1. PATH RESOLUTION & INPUT DISCOVERY]")
    lines.append(f"- Scanned Directories ({len(manifest['discovery']['scanned_directories'])}): {', '.join(manifest['discovery']['scanned_directories']) or 'NONE'}")
    lines.append(f"- Path Resolution Errors ({len(manifest['discovery']['path_resolution_errors'])}):")
    for err in manifest["discovery"]["path_resolution_errors"]:
        lines.append(f"  * ERROR: {json.dumps(err)}")
    lines.append(f"- Duplicate Filenames Across Directories ({len(manifest['discovery']['duplicate_filenames'])}):")
    for dup_name, dup_list in manifest["discovery"]["duplicate_filenames"].items():
        lines.append(f"  * DUP {dup_name}: {dup_list}")
    lines.append(f"- Selected Input Files ({len(manifest['discovery']['selected_files'])}) with SHA-256:")
    for fname, fmeta in manifest["discovery"]["selected_files"].items():
        lines.append(f"  * {fname} [{fmeta['selected_role']}] -> {fmeta['resolved_path']} | {fmeta['size_bytes']}B | sha256={fmeta['sha256']}")
    lines.append(f"- Missing Files ({len(manifest['discovery']['missing_files'])}) — explicitly reported, not treated as empty inputs:")
    for m in manifest["discovery"]["missing_files"]:
        lines.append(f"  * MISSING: {m['filename']} ({m['reason']})")
    lines.append("")

    lines.append("[2. TOKEN & METHOD BODY SIZE VERIFICATION]")
    for fname, tres in manifest["token_and_size_verification"].items():
        lines.append(f"- File: {fname}")
        lines.append(f"  * Unique Tokens Found: {tres['unique_token_count']} | Total Occurrences: {tres['total_token_occurrences']}")
        lines.append(f"  * Matched Expected Tokens: {len(tres['matched_expected_tokens'])}/{len(VERIFIED_TOKENS)}")
        lines.append(f"  * Missing Expected Tokens ({len(tres['missing_expected_tokens'])}): {tres['missing_expected_tokens']}")
        lines.append(f"  * Additional Tokens Count: {tres['additional_tokens_count']} (sample={tres['additional_tokens_sample'][:10]})")
        lines.append(f"  * Duplicate Method Records: {tres['duplicate_method_records']}")
        lines.append(f"  * Mismatched Method-Token Pairs: {tres['mismatched_method_token_pairs']}")
        for sc in tres["method_size_checks"]:
            lines.append(f"  * Size Check [{sc['method']}]: status={sc['status']} expected={sc['expected_bytes']} observed={sc['observed_bytes']}")
    if not manifest["token_and_size_verification"]:
        lines.append("  * No files evaluated (UNVERIFIED due to missing/unselected inputs).")
    lines.append("")

    lines.append("[3. COMBINED EVIDENCE VALIDATION (CORE + PIPE UNION)]")
    lines.append(json.dumps(manifest["combined_evidence_validation"], indent=2))
    lines.append("")

    lines.append("[4. EXPLICIT VERIFICATION STATUS & OUTCOMES]")
    for item in manifest["claim_evaluations"]:
        lines.append(f"- {item['id']}: status={item['status']} | outcome={item['outcome']}")
        lines.append(f"  * Observed: {item['observed_behavior']}")
        if "inferred_hypothesis" in item:
            lines.append(f"  * Inferred (Not Direct Proof): {item['inferred_hypothesis']}")
    lines.append("")

    lines.append("[5. UNRESOLVED EVIDENCE GAPS]")
    gaps = [
        "1_OCEAN_CORE_PART_01.txt, 2_GPU_CPU_PIPELINE_PART_01.txt, and 3_COMBINED_OCEAN_GPU_CPU_PART_01.txt must be present at resolved paths to execute full 1,028-method/token union & byte-level verification.",
        "Reason for omitting Grid 3 from CPU readback in ReadFromGPU (0x06003091) remains UNVERIFIED as a proven design rationale (bandwidth-saving explanation is INFERRED / UNVERIFIED).",
        "Actual GPU shader sampling of Ceto_DisplacementMap3 and CPU query validity when sampleSpectrum[3] is enabled remain UNVERIFIED.",
        "Runtime task completion / caller ordering behavior around SwapDisplacements() (0x06002F7B) and WaveSpectrumBufferCPU.Run (0x06002FBD) requires direct caller/scheduling proof.",
    ]
    for g in gaps:
        lines.append(f"- [UNVERIFIED GAP] {g}")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("EOF_AUDIT_V1")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Gemini Ai Core 1 Fixed Forensic Audit")
    parser.add_argument("--base-dir", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_BASE_DIR)
    parser.add_argument("--data-dir", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_DATA_DIR)
    parser.add_argument("--out-dir", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_OUT_DIR)
    parser.add_argument("--extra-root", type=Path, nargs="*", default=[])
    args = parser.parse_args()

    out_dir = args.out_dir.resolve()
    if is_protected_path(out_dir):
        raise RuntimeError(f"Refusing to write into protected directory: {out_dir}")
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    discovery = resolve_paths_and_discover(args.base_dir, args.data_dir, args.extra_root)
    token_verification = verify_tokens_and_sizes(discovery["selected_files"])
    combined_validation = validate_combined_evidence(discovery["selected_files"], token_verification)
    claim_evals = evaluate_technical_claims(discovery["selected_files"], token_verification, combined_validation)

    manifest = {
        "schema_version": "gemini-ai-core-1-v1",
        "scan_timestamp_utc": dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "discovery": discovery,
        "token_and_size_verification": token_verification,
        "combined_evidence_validation": combined_validation,
        "claim_evaluations": claim_evals,
    }

    report_text = generate_report_text(manifest)
    manifest_path = out_dir / "audit_manifest_v1.json"
    report_path = out_dir / "audit_report_v1.txt"

    manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    report_path.write_text(report_text, encoding="utf-8")

    print(report_text)
    print(f"\nWrote manifest -> {manifest_path}")
    print(f"Wrote report   -> {report_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def compute_sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(65536), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def is_protected_path(path: Path) -> bool:
    return any(part in PROTECTED_DIR_NAMES for part in path.parts)


def walk_files_bounded(root: Path, max_depth: int = 4) -> List[Path]:
    found: List[Path] = []
    root_parts_len = len(root.parts)

    def _walk(curr: Path) -> None:
        if any(part in SKIP_SCAN_DIR_NAMES for part in curr.parts[root_parts_len:]):
            return
        depth = len(curr.parts) - root_parts_len
        try:
            entries = sorted(curr.iterdir(), key=lambda p: p.name)
        except OSError:
            return
        for entry in entries:
            if entry.name in SKIP_SCAN_DIR_NAMES:
                continue
            if entry.is_symlink():
                continue
            if entry.is_file():
                found.append(entry)
            elif entry.is_dir() and depth < max_depth:
                _walk(entry)

    _walk(root)
    return found


def resolve_paths_and_discover(
    base_dir: Path,
    data_dir: Path,
    extra_roots: List[Path],
    max_depth: int = 4,
) -> Dict:
    path_resolution_errors: List[Dict] = []
    missing_files: List[Dict] = []
    duplicate_candidates: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
    scanned_directories: List[str] = []
    selected_files: Dict[str, Dict] = {}

    resolved_base: Optional[Path] = None
    resolved_data: Optional[Path] = None

    try:
        resolved_base = base_dir.resolve(strict=True)
    except Exception as exc:
        path_resolution_errors.append({"role": "BASE_DIR", "configured_path": str(base_dir), "error": str(exc)})

    try:
        resolved_data = data_dir.resolve(strict=True)
    except Exception as exc:
        path_resolution_errors.append({"role": "DATA_DIR", "configured_path": str(data_dir), "error": str(exc)})

    candidate_dirs: List[Tuple[str, Path]] = []
    if resolved_base is not None:
        candidate_dirs.append(("BASE_DIR", resolved_base))
    if resolved_data is not None:
        candidate_dirs.append(("DATA_DIR", resolved_data))
    for idx, extra in enumerate(extra_roots):
        try:
            r_extra = extra.resolve(strict=True)
            candidate_dirs.append((f"EXTRA_ROOT[{idx}]", r_extra))
        except Exception as exc:
            path_resolution_errors.append({"role": f"EXTRA_ROOT[{idx}]", "configured_path": str(extra), "error": str(exc)})

    seen_dirs: Set[Path] = set()
    all_matches_by_name: Dict[str, List[Tuple[str, Path]]] = {name: [] for name in TARGET_INPUT_FILES}

    for role, dpath in candidate_dirs:
        if dpath in seen_dirs:
            continue
        seen_dirs.add(dpath)
        scanned_directories.append(f"{role}:{dpath} (recursive depth<={max_depth})")

        if not dpath.is_dir():
            path_resolution_errors.append({"role": role, "path": str(dpath), "error": "Not a directory"})
            continue

        for entry in walk_files_bounded(dpath, max_depth=max_depth):
            if entry.name in all_matches_by_name and not is_protected_path(entry):
                try:
                    abs_p = entry.resolve(strict=True)
                    all_matches_by_name[entry.name].append((role, abs_p))
                except Exception as exc:
                    path_resolution_errors.append({"role": role, "path": str(entry), "error": str(exc)})

    for fname in TARGET_INPUT_FILES:
        matches = all_matches_by_name[fname]
        if len(matches) > 1:
            duplicate_candidates[fname] = [f"{r}:{str(p)}" for r, p in matches]

        if not matches:
            missing_files.append({
                "filename": fname,
                "status": "MISSING",
                "reason": "File not found in scanned directories (not treated as empty input)",
            })
        else:
            chosen_role, chosen_path = matches[0]
            for r, p in matches:
                if r == "BASE_DIR":
                    chosen_role, chosen_path = r, p
                    break
            st = chosen_path.stat()
            selected_files[fname] = {
                "selected_role": chosen_role,
                "resolved_path": str(chosen_path),
                "size_bytes": st.st_size,
                "modified_utc": dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(st.st_mtime, tz=dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                "sha256": compute_sha256(chosen_path),
                "duplicate_count": len(matches),
            }

    return {
        "resolved_base_dir": str(resolved_base) if resolved_base else None,
        "resolved_data_dir": str(resolved_data) if resolved_data else None,
        "scanned_directories": scanned_directories,
        "path_resolution_errors": path_resolution_errors,
        "missing_files": missing_files,
        "duplicate_filenames": duplicate_candidates,
        "selected_files": selected_files,
    }


def parse_methods_and_tokens(text: str) -> Dict:
    all_token_matches = re.findall(r"\b0x06[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}\b", text)
    normalized_tokens = [t.upper().replace("0X", "0x") for t in all_token_matches]
    unique_tokens: Set[str] = set(normalized_tokens)

    method_records: List[Dict] = []
    block_pattern = re.compile(
        r"(?:TYPE:\s*([^\r\n|]+?)\s*\|\s*)?METHOD:\s*([^\r\n|]+?)\s*\|[^\r\n]*?TOKEN:\s*(0x06[0-9A-Fa-f]{6})[^\r\n]*?(?:SIZE:\s*(\d+)\s*B)?",
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    for m in block_pattern.finditer(text):
        m_type = (m.group(1) or "").strip()
        m_name = (m.group(2) or "").strip()
        m_tok = m.group(3).upper().replace("0X", "0x")
        m_size = int(m.group(4)) if m.group(4) else None
        full_key = f"{m_type}.{m_name}".strip(".") if m_type else m_name
        method_records.append({
            "key": full_key,
            "method": m_name,
            "token": m_tok,
            "size_bytes": m_size,
            "span_start": m.start(),
        })

    # Match summary lines like: "QueryDisplacements | QueryWaves | RVA=0x0007869c | FileOff=0x7689c (Fat, 951B)"
    pipe_summary_pattern = re.compile(
        r"([A-Za-z0-9_.]+\s*\|\s*[A-Za-z0-9_.]+\s*\|[^\r\n]*?\((\w+),\s*(\d+)\s*B\))"
    )
    for m in pipe_summary_pattern.finditer(text):
        raw_line = m.group(1)
        parts = [p.strip() for p in raw_line.split("|")]
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            full_key = f"{parts[0]}.{parts[1]}"
            sz = int(m.group(3))
            method_records.append({
                "key": full_key,
                "method": parts[1],
                "token": None,
                "size_bytes": sz,
                "header_kind": m.group(2),
                "span_start": m.start(),
            })

    # Extract short method bodies/slices around each matched method record to compare content when available
    method_body_hashes: Dict[str, str] = {}
    for rec in method_records:
        start = rec.get("span_start")
        if isinstance(start, int):
            snippet = text[start : start + 4000]
            il_lines = [ln.strip() for ln in snippet.splitlines() if "IL_" in ln or "ld" in ln or "call" in ln or "st" in ln or "br" in ln]
            if il_lines:
                sig = "\n".join(il_lines[:40]).encode("utf-8")
                method_body_hashes[rec["key"]] = hashlib.sha256(sig).hexdigest()

    return {
        "total_token_occurrences": len(normalized_tokens),
        "unique_tokens": sorted(unique_tokens),
        "method_records": method_records,
        "method_body_hashes": method_body_hashes,
    }


def verify_tokens_and_sizes(selected_files: Dict[str, Dict]) -> Dict:
    per_file_results: Dict[str, Dict] = {}
    expected_token_set = {k: v.upper().replace("0X", "0x") for k, v in VERIFIED_TOKENS.items()}
    expected_values_set = set(expected_token_set.values())

    for fname, meta in selected_files.items():
        p = Path(meta["resolved_path"])
        if not p.exists():
            continue
        text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        parsed = parse_methods_and_tokens(text)
        found_set = set(parsed["unique_tokens"])

        missing_expected = {name: tok for name, tok in expected_token_set.items() if tok not in found_set}
        additional_tokens = sorted(found_set - expected_values_set)
        matched_expected = {name: tok for name, tok in expected_token_set.items() if tok in found_set}

        observed_sizes: Dict[str, List[int]] = {}
        for rec in parsed["method_records"]:
            if rec["size_bytes"] is not None:
                observed_sizes.setdefault(rec["key"], []).append(rec["size_bytes"])
                observed_sizes.setdefault(rec["method"], []).append(rec["size_bytes"])

        size_checks: List[Dict] = []
        for target_method, expected_sz in METHOD_BODY_SIZES.items():
            short_name = target_method.split(".")[-1]
            obs_list = observed_sizes.get(target_method) or observed_sizes.get(short_name) or []
            if not obs_list:
                size_checks.append({
                    "method": target_method,
                    "expected_bytes": expected_sz,
                    "observed_bytes": None,
                    "status": "UNVERIFIED",
                    "reason": "No explicit byte-size record parsed for method in this file",
                })
            else:
                matches_exact = [s for s in obs_list if s == expected_sz]
                mismatches = [s for s in obs_list if s != expected_sz]
                size_checks.append({
                    "method": target_method,
                    "expected_bytes": expected_sz,
                    "observed_bytes": obs_list,
                    "matched_count": len(matches_exact),
                    "mismatched_values": mismatches,
                    "status": "VERIFIED" if (matches_exact and not mismatches) else ("PARTIALLY VERIFIED" if matches_exact else "FAIL"),
                })

        mismatched_pairs: List[Dict] = []
        for rec in parsed["method_records"]:
            if rec["token"] and rec["key"] in expected_token_set:
                exp_t = expected_token_set[rec["key"]]
                if rec["token"] != exp_t:
                    mismatched_pairs.append({
                        "method": rec["key"],
                        "expected_token": exp_t,
                        "observed_token": rec["token"],
                    })

        rec_key_counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
        for rec in parsed["method_records"]:
            if rec["key"]:
                rec_key_counts[rec["key"]] = rec_key_counts.get(rec["key"], 0) + 1
        duplicate_method_records = {k: c for k, c in rec_key_counts.items() if c > 1}

        per_file_results[fname] = {
            "unique_token_count": len(found_set),
            "total_token_occurrences": parsed["total_token_occurrences"],
            "matched_expected_tokens": matched_expected,
            "missing_expected_tokens": missing_expected,
            "additional_tokens_count": len(additional_tokens),
            "additional_tokens_sample": additional_tokens[:25],
            "parsed_method_records_count": len(parsed["method_records"]),
            "parsed_body_hashes_count": len(parsed["method_body_hashes"]),
            "duplicate_method_records": duplicate_method_records,
            "mismatched_method_token_pairs": mismatched_pairs,
            "method_size_checks": size_checks,
        }

    return per_file_results


def validate_combined_evidence(selected_files: Dict[str, Dict]) -> Dict:
    has_core = CORE_FILENAME in selected_files
    has_pipe = PIPE_FILENAME in selected_files
    has_comb = COMB_FILENAME in selected_files

    if not (has_core and has_pipe and has_comb):
        present = [n for n in (CORE_FILENAME, PIPE_FILENAME, COMB_FILENAME) if n in selected_files]
        missing = [n for n in (CORE_FILENAME, PIPE_FILENAME, COMB_FILENAME) if n not in selected_files]
        return {
            "status": "UNVERIFIED",
            "verdict": "MISSING_INPUTS",
            "is_independent_source": False,
            "present_files": present,
            "missing_files": missing,
            "reason": "Cannot verify exact/partial union until 1_OCEAN_CORE_PART_01.txt, 2_GPU_CPU_PIPELINE_PART_01.txt, and 3_COMBINED_OCEAN_GPU_CPU_PART_01.txt are all present.",
        }

    core_text = Path(selected_files[CORE_FILENAME]["resolved_path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    pipe_text = Path(selected_files[PIPE_FILENAME]["resolved_path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    comb_text = Path(selected_files[COMB_FILENAME]["resolved_path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

    core_p = parse_methods_and_tokens(core_text)
    pipe_p = parse_methods_and_tokens(pipe_text)
    comb_p = parse_methods_and_tokens(comb_text)

    core_toks = set(core_p["unique_tokens"])
    pipe_toks = set(pipe_p["unique_tokens"])
    comb_toks = set(comb_p["unique_tokens"])
    union_toks = core_toks | pipe_toks

    core_bodies = core_p["method_body_hashes"]
    pipe_bodies = pipe_p["method_body_hashes"]
    comb_bodies = comb_p["method_body_hashes"]
    union_bodies = {**core_bodies, **pipe_bodies}

    body_mismatches = []
    for k, expected_h in union_bodies.items():
        if k in comb_bodies and comb_bodies[k] != expected_h:
            body_mismatches.append({"method": k, "expected_body_hash": expected_h, "combined_body_hash": comb_bodies[k]})

    missing_toks = sorted(union_toks - comb_toks)
    extra_toks = sorted(comb_toks - union_toks)
    missing_bodies = sorted(set(union_bodies.keys()) - set(comb_bodies.keys()))
    extra_bodies = sorted(set(comb_bodies.keys()) - set(union_bodies.keys()))

    if not missing_toks and not extra_toks and not body_mismatches and not missing_bodies and not extra_bodies:
        classification = "EXACT_UNION_INCLUDING_METHOD_BODIES"
        status = "VERIFIED"
    elif body_mismatches or extra_toks or extra_bodies:
        classification = "CONFLICTING_OR_EXTRA_CONTENT"
        status = "PARTIALLY VERIFIED"
    else:
        classification = "PARTIAL_UNION"
        status = "PARTIALLY VERIFIED"

    return {
        "status": status,
        "classification": classification,
        "is_independent_source": False,
        "independence_note": "Combined file is evaluated strictly as a merged representation of CORE and PIPE, never as an independent source.",
        "core_unique_tokens": len(core_toks),
        "pipe_unique_tokens": len(pipe_toks),
        "combined_unique_tokens": len(comb_toks),
        "union_unique_tokens": len(union_toks),
        "missing_tokens_in_combined": missing_toks,
        "extra_tokens_in_combined": extra_toks,
        "missing_method_bodies_in_combined": missing_bodies,
        "extra_method_bodies_in_combined": extra_bodies,
        "method_body_hash_mismatches": body_mismatches,
    }


def evaluate_technical_claims(selected_files: Dict[str, Dict], token_results: Dict[str, Dict], combined_eval: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
    # Concatenate loaded evidence text to check actual text/IL indicators rather than token existence alone
    corpus_parts: List[str] = []
    for fname, meta in selected_files.items():
        p = Path(meta["resolved_path"])
        if p.exists() and p.stat().st_size <= 5_000_000:
            corpus_parts.append(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
    corpus = "\n".join(corpus_parts)

    has_readfromgpu_grid_evidence = ("ReadFromGPU" in corpus and "0x06003091" in corpus and ("Grid 3" in corpus or "numGrids" in corpus))
    has_swap_order_evidence = ("SwapDisplacements" in corpus and "0x06002F7B" in corpus and "0x06002F78" in corpus)
    has_sample_clamp_evidence = ("Sample" in corpus and ("-40" in corpus or "Clamp" in corpus))

    return [
        {
            "id": "GRID3_READBACK_OBSERVATION",
            "observed_behavior": "Presence of ReadFromGPU (0x06003091) and Grid/numGrids references in loaded audit texts; full raw IL instruction body audit of ReadFromGPU is required for strict byte-level proof.",
            "status": "PARTIALLY VERIFIED" if has_readfromgpu_grid_evidence else "UNVERIFIED",
            "outcome": "PARTIAL" if has_readfromgpu_grid_evidence else "FAIL (MISSING_INPUT_EVIDENCE)",
        },
        {
            "id": "GRID3_SKIP_REASON_BANDWIDTH",
            "observed_behavior": "Bandwidth-saving rationale is not treated as proven IL fact; separated as an unverified inference.",
            "status": "UNVERIFIED",
            "inferred_hypothesis": "Avoiding GPU-to-CPU readback transfer for Grid 3 is an inferred explanation, not direct proof of intent.",
            "outcome": "UNVERIFIED",
        },
        {
            "id": "GRID3_TEXTURE_BINDING_AND_SHADER_CONSUMPTION",
            "observed_behavior": "GenerateDisplacement (0x06003090) and Ceto_DisplacementMap0..3 references vs end-to-end shader consumption and sampleSpectrum[3] CPU query data validity.",
            "status": "PARTIALLY VERIFIED" if ("0x06003090" in corpus and "DisplacementMap" in corpus) else "UNVERIFIED",
            "outcome": "PARTIAL",
        },
        {
            "id": "CPU_BUFFER_SWAP_ORDER",
            "observed_behavior": "SwapDisplacements (0x06002F7B) and DisplacementBufferCPU.Run (0x06002F78) ordering vs runtime task completion / caller ordering verification.",
            "status": "PARTIALLY VERIFIED" if has_swap_order_evidence else "UNVERIFIED",
            "outcome": "PARTIAL",
        },
        {
            "id": "COMBINED_UNION_VALIDATION",
            "observed_behavior": combined_eval.get("classification", "UNVERIFIED"),
            "status": combined_eval.get("status", "UNVERIFIED"),
            "outcome": combined_eval.get("verdict", "PARTIAL"),
        },
        {
            "id": "SAMPLING_AND_CLAMP_PIPELINE",
            "observed_behavior": "Sample / SampleHeightOnly and [-40, 40] clamp references in loaded reports.",
            "status": "PARTIALLY VERIFIED" if has_sample_clamp_evidence else "UNVERIFIED",
            "outcome": "PARTIAL",
        },
    ]


def generate_report_text(manifest: Dict) -> str:
    lines: List[str] = []
    lines.append("=" * 78)

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Gemini Ai Core V2 Upgraded Forensic Audit")
    parser.add_argument("--base-dir", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_BASE_DIR)
    parser.add_argument("--data-dir", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_DATA_DIR)
    parser.add_argument("--out-dir", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_OUT_DIR)
    parser.add_argument("--extra-root", type=Path, nargs="*", default=[])
    parser.add_argument("--max-depth", type=int, default=4)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    out_dir = args.out_dir.resolve()
    if is_protected_path(out_dir):
        raise RuntimeError(f"Refusing to write into protected directory: {out_dir}")
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    discovery = resolve_paths_and_discover(args.base_dir, args.data_dir, args.extra_root, max_depth=args.max_depth)
    token_verification = verify_tokens_and_sizes(discovery["selected_files"])
    combined_validation = validate_combined_evidence(discovery["selected_files"])
    claim_evals = evaluate_technical_claims(discovery["selected_files"], token_verification, combined_validation)

    manifest = {
        "schema_version": "gemini-ai-core-2-upgraded",
        "scan_timestamp_utc": dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "discovery": discovery,
        "token_and_size_verification": token_verification,
        "combined_evidence_validation": combined_validation,
        "claim_evaluations": claim_evals,
    }

    manifest_path = out_dir / "audit_manifest_v2.json"
    report_path = out_dir / "audit_report_v2.txt"
    report_text = generate_report_text(manifest)

    manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    report_path.write_text(report_text, encoding="utf-8")

    print(report_text)
    print(f"\nWrote manifest -> {manifest_path}")
    print(f"Wrote report   -> {report_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os
import struct
import hashlib
from datetime import datetime

DLL_PATH = "/mnt/sdcard/Download/Stranded-Deep-Original/Stranded Deep/Stranded_Deep_Data/Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll"

class RawPEMetadata:
    def __init__(self, path):
        with open(path, "rb") as f:
            self.data = f.read()
        self.sha256 = hashlib.sha256(self.data).hexdigest()
        self.sections = []
        self._parse_pe()
        self._parse_cli()

    def _parse_pe(self):
        pe_off = struct.unpack_from("<I", self.data, 0x3C)[0]
        assert self.data[pe_off:pe_off+4] == b"PE\x00\x00"
        num_sec = struct.unpack_from("<H", self.data, pe_off + 6)[0]
        opt_size = struct.unpack_from("<H", self.data, pe_off + 20)[0]
        opt_off = pe_off + 24
        magic = struct.unpack_from("<H", self.data, opt_off)[0]
        dd_off = opt_off + (96 if magic == 0x10B else 112)
        self.cli_rva, self.cli_size = struct.unpack_from("<II", self.data, dd_off + 14 * 8)
        sec_off = opt_off + opt_size
        for i in range(num_sec):
            s = sec_off + i * 40
            vsize, vrva, rsize, roff = struct.unpack_from("<IIII", self.data, s + 8)
            self.sections.append((vrva, vsize, roff, rsize))

    def rva_to_offset(self, rva):
        if rva == 0:
            return 0
        for vrva, vsize, roff, rsize in self.sections:
            span = max(vsize, rsize)
            if vrva <= rva < vrva + span:
                return roff + (rva - vrva)
        return 0

    def _parse_cli(self):
        cli_off = self.rva_to_offset(self.cli_rva)
        meta_rva, meta_size = struct.unpack_from("<II", self.data, cli_off + 8)
        meta_off = self.rva_to_offset(meta_rva)
        ver_len = struct.unpack_from("<I", self.data, meta_off + 12)[0]
        ver_len_aligned = (ver_len + 3) & ~3
        num_streams = struct.unpack_from("<H", self.data, meta_off + 16 + ver_len_aligned + 2)[0]
        pos = meta_off + 16 + ver_len_aligned + 4
        self.streams = {}
        for _ in range(num_streams):
            soff, ssize = struct.unpack_from("<II", self.data, pos)
            pos += 8
            end = self.data.find(b"\x00", pos)
            name = self.data[pos:end].decode("ascii", errors="replace")
            pos = (end + 4) & ~3
            self.streams[name] = (meta_off + soff, ssize)
        self._parse_tables()

    def _get_string(self, idx):
        off, size = self.streams["#Strings"]
        if idx >= size:
            return ""
        end = self.data.find(b"\x00", off + idx)
        return self.data[off + idx:end].decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

    def _get_user_string(self, offset):
        off, size = self.streams["#US"]
        if offset >= size:
            return ""
        p = off + offset
        b0 = self.data[p]
        if (b0 & 0x80) == 0:
            length = b0; p += 1
        elif (b0 & 0xC0) == 0x80:
            length = ((b0 & 0x3F) << 8) | self.data[p+1]; p += 2
        else:
            length = ((b0 & 0x1F) << 24) | (self.data[p+1] << 16) | (self.data[p+2] << 8) | self.data[p+3]; p += 4
        if length <= 1:
            return ""
        raw = self.data[p:p + length - 1]
        return raw.decode("utf-16le", errors="replace")
    def _parse_tables(self):
        off, _ = self.streams["#~"]
        heap_sizes = self.data[off + 6]
        valid_mask = struct.unpack_from("<Q", self.data, off + 8)[0]
        str_idx_sz = 4 if (heap_sizes & 0x01) else 2
        guid_idx_sz = 4 if (heap_sizes & 0x02) else 2
        blob_idx_sz = 4 if (heap_sizes & 0x04) else 2

        pos = off + 24
        row_counts = {}
        for tid in range(64):
            if (valid_mask >> tid) & 1:
                row_counts[tid] = struct.unpack_from("<I", self.data, pos)[0]
                pos += 4

        def idx_sz(tids):
            return 4 if any(row_counts.get(t, 0) >= 65536 for t in tids) else 2

        def coded_sz(tids, tag_bits):
            limit = 1 << (16 - tag_bits)
            return 4 if any(row_counts.get(t, 0) >= limit for t in tids) else 2

        td_or_tr = coded_sz([0x02, 0x01, 0x1B], 2)
        has_const = coded_sz([0x04, 0x08, 0x17], 2)
        has_ca = coded_sz([0x06, 0x04, 0x01, 0x02, 0x08, 0x09, 0x0A, 0x00, 0x0E, 0x17, 0x14, 0x11, 0x1A, 0x1B, 0x20, 0x23, 0x26, 0x27, 0x28], 5)
        has_fm = coded_sz([0x04, 0x08], 1)
        has_decl = coded_sz([0x02, 0x06, 0x20], 2)
        mr_parent = coded_sz([0x02, 0x01, 0x1A, 0x06, 0x1B], 3)
        has_sem = coded_sz([0x14, 0x17], 1)
        md_or_mr = coded_sz([0x06, 0x0A], 1)
        impl = coded_sz([0x04, 0x0A], 1)
        ca_type = coded_sz([0x06, 0x0A], 3)
        res_scope = coded_sz([0x00, 0x1A, 0x23, 0x01], 2)
        to_md = coded_sz([0x02, 0x06], 1)

        row_sizes = {
            0x00: 2 + str_idx_sz + guid_idx_sz * 3,
            0x01: res_scope + str_idx_sz * 2,
            0x02: 4 + str_idx_sz * 2 + td_or_tr + idx_sz([0x04]) + idx_sz([0x06]),
            0x04: 2 + str_idx_sz + blob_idx_sz,
            0x06: 4 + 2 + 2 + str_idx_sz + blob_idx_sz + idx_sz([0x08]),
            0x08: 2 + 2 + str_idx_sz,
            0x09: idx_sz([0x02]) + td_or_tr,
            0x0A: mr_parent + str_idx_sz + blob_idx_sz,
            0x0B: 2 + has_const + blob_idx_sz,
            0x0C: has_ca + ca_type + blob_idx_sz,
            0x0D: has_fm + blob_idx_sz,
            0x0E: 2 + has_decl + blob_idx_sz,
            0x0F: 2 + 4 + idx_sz([0x02]),
            0x10: 4 + idx_sz([0x04]),
            0x11: blob_idx_sz,
            0x12: idx_sz([0x02]) + idx_sz([0x14]),
            0x14: 2 + str_idx_sz + td_or_tr,
            0x15: idx_sz([0x02]) + idx_sz([0x17]),
            0x17: 2 + str_idx_sz + blob_idx_sz,
            0x18: 2 + idx_sz([0x06]) + has_sem,
            0x19: idx_sz([0x02]) + md_or_mr + md_or_mr,
            0x1A: str_idx_sz,
            0x1B: blob_idx_sz,
            0x1C: 2 + impl + str_idx_sz + idx_sz([0x1A]),
            0x1D: 4 + idx_sz([0x04]),
            0x20: 4 + 8 + 4 + blob_idx_sz + str_idx_sz * 2,
            0x23: 8 + 4 + blob_idx_sz + str_idx_sz * 2 + blob_idx_sz,
            0x26: 4 + 4 + str_idx_sz + impl,
            0x27: 4 + 4 + str_idx_sz * 2 + impl,
            0x28: 4 + 4 + str_idx_sz + impl,
            0x29: idx_sz([0x02]) + idx_sz([0x02]),
            0x2A: 2 + 2 + to_md + str_idx_sz,
            0x2B: md_or_mr + blob_idx_sz,
            0x2C: idx_sz([0x2A]) + td_or_tr,
        }

        table_offsets = {}
        for tid in range(64):
            cnt = row_counts.get(tid, 0)
            if cnt > 0:
                table_offsets[tid] = pos
                pos += cnt * row_sizes[tid]

        td_cnt = row_counts.get(0x02, 0)
        td_off = table_offsets.get(0x02, 0)
        td_rsz = row_sizes[0x02]
        typedefs = []
        for rid in range(1, td_cnt + 1):
            r = td_off + (rid - 1) * td_rsz
            name_i = struct.unpack_from("<I" if str_idx_sz == 4 else "<H", self.data, r + 4)[0]
            ns_i = struct.unpack_from("<I" if str_idx_sz == 4 else "<H", self.data, r + 4 + str_idx_sz)[0]
            mlist_off = r + 4 + str_idx_sz * 2 + td_or_tr + idx_sz([0x04])
            mlist = struct.unpack_from("<I" if idx_sz([0x06]) == 4 else "<H", self.data, mlist_off)[0]
            typedefs.append((rid, self._get_string(ns_i), self._get_string(name_i), mlist))

        md_cnt = row_counts.get(0x06, 0)
        md_off = table_offsets.get(0x06, 0)
        md_rsz = row_sizes[0x06]
        self.methods = {}
        td_idx = 0
        for rid in range(1, md_cnt + 1):
            while td_idx + 1 < len(typedefs) and typedefs[td_idx + 1][3] <= rid:
                td_idx += 1
            ns, tname = typedefs[td_idx][1], typedefs[td_idx][2]
            full_type = f"{ns}.{tname}" if ns else tname
            r = md_off + (rid - 1) * md_rsz
            rva = struct.unpack_from("<I", self.data, r)[0]
            name_i = struct.unpack_from("<I" if str_idx_sz == 4 else "<H", self.data, r + 8)[0]
            mname = self._get_string(name_i)
            token = 0x06000000 | rid
            self.methods[token] = {
                "token": token, "rid": rid, "type": full_type,
                "name": mname, "rva": rva, "offset": self.rva_to_offset(rva)
            }

        fd_cnt = row_counts.get(0x04, 0)
        fd_off = table_offsets.get(0x04, 0)
        fd_rsz = row_sizes[0x04]
        self.fields = {}
        for rid in range(1, fd_cnt + 1):
            r = fd_off + (rid - 1) * fd_rsz
            name_i = struct.unpack_from("<I" if str_idx_sz == 4 else "<H", self.data, r + 2)[0]
            self.fields[0x04000000 | rid] = self._get_string(name_i)

        mr_cnt = row_counts.get(0x0A, 0)
        mr_off = table_offsets.get(0x0A, 0)
        mr_rsz = row_sizes[0x0A]
        self.memberrefs = {}
        for rid in range(1, mr_cnt + 1):
            r = mr_off + (rid - 1) * mr_rsz
            name_i = struct.unpack_from("<I" if str_idx_sz == 4 else "<H", self.data, r + mr_parent)[0]
            self.memberrefs[0x0A000000 | rid] = self._get_string(name_i)

    def resolve_token(self, tok):
        tbl = tok >> 24
        if tbl == 0x06 and tok in self.methods:
            m = self.methods[tok]
            return f"{m['type']}.{m['name']}"
        if tbl == 0x04 and tok in self.fields:
            return f"Field:{self.fields[tok]}"
        if tbl == 0x0A and tok in self.memberrefs:
            return f"Ref:{self.memberrefs[tok]}"
        if tbl == 0x70:
            return f"US:'{self._get_user_string(tok & 0x00FFFFFF)}'"
        return f"0x{tok:08X}"

    0xA0: ("stelem.r4", 0), 0xA1: ("stelem.r8", 0), 0xA2: ("stelem.ref", 0), 0xA3: ("ldelem", 4),
    0xA4: ("stelem", 4), 0xA5: ("unbox.any", 4), 0xB3: ("conv.ovf.i1", 0), 0xB4: ("conv.ovf.u1", 0),
    0xB5: ("conv.ovf.i2", 0), 0xB6: ("conv.ovf.u2", 0), 0xB7: ("conv.ovf.i4", 0), 0xB8: ("conv.ovf.u4", 0),
    0xB9: ("conv.ovf.i8", 0), 0xBA: ("conv.ovf.u8", 0), 0xC2: ("refanyval", 4), 0xC3: ("ckfinite", 0),
    0xC6: ("mkrefany", 4), 0xD0: ("ldtoken", 4), 0xD1: ("conv.u2", 0), 0xD2: ("conv.u1", 0),
    0xD3: ("conv.i", 0), 0xD4: ("conv.ovf.i", 0), 0xD5: ("conv.ovf.u", 0), 0xD6: ("add.ovf", 0),
    0xD7: ("add.ovf.un", 0), 0xD8: ("mul.ovf", 0), 0xD9: ("mul.ovf.un", 0), 0xDA: ("sub.ovf", 0),
    0xDB: ("sub.ovf.un", 0), 0xDC: ("endfinally", 0), 0xDD: ("leave", -4), 0xDE: ("leave.s", -1),
    0xDF: ("stind.i", 0), 0xE0: ("conv.u", 0)
}

FE_OP = {
    0x00: ("arglist", 0), 0x01: ("ceq", 0), 0x02: ("cgt", 0), 0x03: ("cgt.un", 0),
    0x04: ("clt", 0), 0x05: ("clt.un", 0), 0x06: ("ldftn", 4), 0x07: ("ldvirtftn", 4),
    0x09: ("ldarg", 2), 0x0A: ("ldarga", 2), 0x0B: ("starg", 2), 0x0C: ("ldloc", 2),
    0x0D: ("ldloca", 2), 0x0E: ("stloc", 2), 0x0F: ("localloc", 0), 0x11: ("endfilter", 0),
    0x12: ("unaligned.", 1), 0x13: ("volatile.", 0), 0x14: ("tail.", 0), 0x15: ("initobj", 4),
    0x16: ("constrained.", 4), 0x17: ("cpblk", 0), 0x18: ("initblk", 0), 0x1A: ("rethrow", 0),
    0x1C: ("sizeof", 4), 0x1D: ("refanytype", 0), 0x1E: ("readonly.", 0)
}

def decode_method_body(pe, method_info):
    off = method_info["offset"]
    if off == 0:
        return {"status": "ABSTRACT_OR_EXTERN", "size": 0, "decoded": 0, "insns": [], "errors": 0, "bad_br": 0}
    b0 = pe.data[off]
    fmt = b0 & 0x03
    if fmt == 0x02:
        code_size = b0 >> 2
        body_off = off + 1
    elif fmt == 0x03:
        code_size = struct.unpack_from("<I", pe.data, off + 4)[0]
        body_off = off + 12
    else:
        return {"status": "UNKNOWN_HEADER", "size": 0, "decoded": 0, "insns": [], "errors": 1, "bad_br": 0}

    code = pe.data[body_off:body_off + code_size]
    pc = 0
    insns = []
    offsets = set()
    branches = []
    errors = 0

    while pc < code_size:
        offsets.add(pc)
        start_pc = pc
        op = code[pc]
        pc += 1
        if op == 0xFE:
            if pc >= code_size:
                errors += 1; break
            op2 = code[pc]; pc += 1
            if op2 not in FE_OP:
                errors += 1; insns.append((start_pc, f"UNKNOWN_FE_{op2:02X}", "")); break
            mnem, arg_sz = FE_OP[op2]
        else:
            if op not in SINGLE_OP:
                errors += 1; insns.append((start_pc, f"UNKNOWN_{op:02X}", "")); break
            mnem, arg_sz = SINGLE_OP[op]

        operand_str = ""
        if arg_sz == 1:
            operand_str = f"0x{code[pc]:02X}"; pc += 1
        elif arg_sz == 2:
            val = struct.unpack_from("<H", code, pc)[0]; pc += 2
            operand_str = f"0x{val:04X}"
        elif arg_sz == 4:
            val = struct.unpack_from("<I", code, pc)[0]; pc += 4
            if mnem == "ldc.r4":
                fval = struct.unpack("<f", struct.pack("<I", val))[0]
                operand_str = f"{fval}"
            elif mnem in ("call", "callvirt", "newobj", "ldfld", "ldflda", "stfld", "ldsfld", "ldsflda", "stsfld", "ldstr", "newarr", "ldelema", "ldelem", "stelem", "box", "unbox.any", "castclass", "isinst", "ldtoken", "initobj", "constrained."):
                operand_str = f"0x{val:08X} [{pe.resolve_token(val)}]"
            else:
                operand_str = f"0x{val:08X}"
        elif arg_sz == 8:
            val = struct.unpack_from("<Q", code, pc)[0]; pc += 8
            operand_str = f"0x{val:016X}"
        elif arg_sz == -1:
            rel = struct.unpack_from("<b", code, pc)[0]; pc += 1
            target = pc + rel
            branches.append((start_pc, target))
            operand_str = f"IL_{target:04X}"
        elif arg_sz == -4:
            rel = struct.unpack_from("<i", code, pc)[0]; pc += 4
            target = pc + rel
            branches.append((start_pc, target))
            operand_str = f"IL_{target:04X}"
        elif arg_sz == -99:
            cnt = struct.unpack_from("<I", code, pc)[0]; pc += 4
            base_pc = pc + cnt * 4
            targs = []
            for _ in range(cnt):
                rel = struct.unpack_from("<i", code, pc)[0]; pc += 4
                t = base_pc + rel
                branches.append((start_pc, t))
                targs.append(f"IL_{t:04X}")
            operand_str = f"[{', '.join(targs)}]"

        insns.append((start_pc, mnem, operand_str))

    bad_br = sum(1 for _, t in branches if t not in offsets and t != code_size)
    status = "VERIFIED" if (pc == code_size and errors == 0 and bad_br == 0) else "MISMATCH"
    return {"status": status, "size": code_size, "decoded": pc, "insns": insns, "errors": errors, "bad_br": bad_br}
def main():
    os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    pe = RawPEMetadata(DLL_PATH)

    ceto_methods = [
        m for m in pe.methods.values()
        if m["type"].startswith("Ceto.") or "Ocean" in m["type"] or "Wave" in m["type"] or "Fourier" in m["type"] or "Displacement" in m["type"]
    ]
    ceto_methods.sort(key=lambda x: x["token"])

    verified_cnt = 0
    abstract_cnt = 0
    mismatch_cnt = 0
    decoded_cache = {}
    for m in ceto_methods:
        res = decode_method_body(pe, m)
        decoded_cache[m["token"]] = res
        if res["status"] == "VERIFIED":
            verified_cnt += 1
        elif res["status"] == "ABSTRACT_OR_EXTERN":
            abstract_cnt += 1
        else:
            mismatch_cnt += 1

    def dump_method(tok):
        m = pe.methods[tok]
        d = decoded_cache[tok]
        lines = [f"--- {m['type']}.{m['name']} (Token: 0x{tok:08X} | RID: {m['rid']} | RVA: 0x{m['rva']:X} | Size: {d['size']}B | Status: {d['status']}) ---"]
        for pc, mnem, op in d["insns"]:
            lines.append(f"  IL_{pc:04X}: {mnem:<14} {op}")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    grid3_refs = []
    swap_callers = []
    shader_bindings = []
    for tok, m in pe.methods.items():
        d = decoded_cache[tok] if tok in decoded_cache else decode_method_body(pe, m)
        for pc, mnem, op in d["insns"]:
            if any(k in op for k in ["Ceto_DisplacementMap3", "sampleSpectrum", "ReadFromGPU", "m_displacementMaps"]):
                grid3_refs.append(f"  0x{tok:08X} {m['type']}.{m['name']} @ IL_{pc:04X}: {mnem} {op}")
            if any(k in op for k in ["0x06002F78", "0x06002F7B", "0x06002FBD", "0x06003090"]):
                swap_callers.append(f"  0x{tok:08X} {m['type']}.{m['name']} @ IL_{pc:04X}: {mnem} {op}")
            if m["type"].startswith("Ceto.") and mnem == "ldstr" and ("Ceto_" in op or "read" in op.lower() or "fourier" in op.lower()):
                shader_bindings.append(f"  0x{tok:08X} {m['type']}.{m['name']} @ IL_{pc:04X}: {op}")

    report = [
        "=" * 92,
        "GOOGLE AI CORE — PHASE 1 DEEP FORENSIC AUDIT REPORT",
        f"Generated : {datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds')}",
        f"Target DLL: {DLL_PATH}",
        f"DLL SHA256: {pe.sha256}",
        "=" * 92, "",
        "[SECTION 1: GRID 3 FULL TRACE — SHADER CONSUMPTION, QUERY BUFFER & ALTERNATE PATHS]",
        "-" * 92,
        "1.1 Cross-DLL Reference Scan for Ceto_DisplacementMap3 / sampleSpectrum / m_displacementMaps:"
    ]
    report.extend(grid3_refs[:60])
    report.extend([
        "", "1.2 Raw IL Proof — WaveSpectrum.ReadFromGPU (0x06003091):",
        dump_method(0x06003091),
        "", "1.3 Raw IL Proof — WaveQuery..ctor (0x06002F44) & SetQueryWavesSampling (0x06002E51):",
        dump_method(0x06002F44),
        dump_method(0x06002E51),
        "", "[SECTION 2: CPU BUFFER STATE VERIFICATION — CALLER ORDER, SWAP & TASK COMPLETION]",
        "-" * 92,
        "2.1 Callers of DisplacementBufferCPU.Run (0x06002F78) & WaveSpectrumBufferCPU.Run (0x06002FBD):"
    ])
    report.extend(swap_callers)
    report.extend([
        "", "2.2 Raw IL Proof — DisplacementBufferCPU.Run (0x06002F78), SwapDisplacements (0x06002F7B), Initilize (0x06002F75):",
        dump_method(0x06002F78),
        dump_method(0x06002F7B),
        dump_method(0x06002F75),
        "", "2.3 Raw IL Proof — WaveSpectrumBufferCPU.Run (0x06002FBD):",
        dump_method(0x06002FBD),
        "", "[SECTION 3: INDEPENDENT RAW BYTE DECODER — FULL CETO / OCEAN METHOD AUDIT]",
        "-" * 92,
        f"  - Total Target Methods Scanned : {len(ceto_methods)}",
        f"  - 100% Byte-Verified Methods   : {verified_cnt}",
        f"  - Abstract / Interface (RVA=0) : {abstract_cnt}",
        f"  - Decode / Branch Mismatches   : {mismatch_cnt}",
        f"  - Parser Dependency            : ZERO (Pure Python struct + ECMA-335 CLI/CIL decoder)",
        "", "[SECTION 4: GPU FFT & SHADER UNIFORM / KERNEL BINDING VERIFICATION]",
        "-" * 92,
        "4.1 Raw IL Proof — WaveSpectrumBufferGPU.Initilize (0x06002FC5) & FourierGPU.PeformFFT (0x0600303A):",
        dump_method(0x06002FC5),
        dump_method(0x0600303A),
        "", "4.2 All Ceto Shader Uniforms & Compute Kernels Bound in IL:"
    ])
    report.extend(sorted(set(shader_bindings)))
    report.extend(["", "=" * 92, "END OF AUDIT REPORT", "=" * 92])

    with open(OUT_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(report))

    print(f"[OK] Saved -> {OUT_FILE}")
    print(f"[STATS] Scanned={len(ceto_methods)} | Verified={verified_cnt} | Abstract={abstract_cnt} | Mismatch={mismatch_cnt}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

--- FILE: /storage/emulated/0/Download/Stranded-Deep-Original/Google Ai Core V2/run_hardened_v2_audit.py ---
import os
import json
import struct
import hashlib
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DEFAULT_DLL = SCRIPT_DIR.parent / "Stranded Deep" / "Stranded_Deep_Data" / "Managed" / "Assembly-CSharp.dll"

class HardenedPE:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.path = str(Path(path).resolve())
        if not os.path.exists(self.path):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"DLL not found: {self.path}")
        with open(self.path, "rb") as f:
            self.data = f.read()
        self.size = len(self.data)
        self.sha256 = hashlib.sha256(self.data).hexdigest()
        self.sections = []
        self._parse_pe()
        self._parse_cli()

    def _fail(self, msg):
        raise ValueError(f"[PE/CLI VALIDATION ERROR] {msg}")

    def _u16(self, off, ctx=""):
        if off < 0 or off + 2 > self.size:
            self._fail(f"OOB u16 ({ctx}) @ 0x{off:X}")
        return struct.unpack_from("<H", self.data, off)[0]

    def _u32(self, off, ctx=""):
        if off < 0 or off + 4 > self.size:
            self._fail(f"OOB u32 ({ctx}) @ 0x{off:X}")
        return struct.unpack_from("<I", self.data, off)[0]

    def _u64(self, off, ctx=""):
        if off < 0 or off + 8 > self.size:
            self._fail(f"OOB u64 ({ctx}) @ 0x{off:X}")
        return struct.unpack_from("<Q", self.data, off)[0]

    def _parse_pe(self):
        if self.size < 0x40 or self.data[:2] != b"MZ":
            self._fail("Invalid DOS MZ signature")
        pe_off = self._u32(0x3C, "e_lfanew")
        if pe_off + 24 > self.size or self.data[pe_off:pe_off+4] != b"PE\x00\x00":
            self._fail("Invalid PE signature")
        num_sec = self._u16(pe_off + 6, "NumberOfSections")
        opt_size = self._u16(pe_off + 20, "SizeOfOptionalHeader")
        opt_off = pe_off + 24
        if opt_off + opt_size > self.size or opt_size < 96:
            self._fail("OptionalHeader exceeds file bounds")
        magic = self._u16(opt_off, "OptionalHeader.Magic")
        if magic not in (0x10B, 0x20B):
            self._fail(f"Unknown OptionalHeader magic: 0x{magic:X}")
        dd_off = opt_off + (96 if magic == 0x10B else 112)
        if dd_off + 15 * 8 > opt_off + opt_size:
            self._fail("DataDirectory CLI entry outside OptionalHeader")
        self.cli_rva = self._u32(dd_off + 14 * 8, "CLI_RVA")
        self.cli_size = self._u32(dd_off + 14 * 8 + 4, "CLI_Size")
        if self.cli_rva == 0 or self.cli_size < 72:
            self._fail("Missing or truncated CLI header")
        sec_off = opt_off + opt_size
        if sec_off + num_sec * 40 > self.size:
            self._fail("Section table exceeds file bounds")
        for i in range(num_sec):
            s = sec_off + i * 40
            vsize = self._u32(s + 8, f"Sec[{i}].VSize")
            vrva = self._u32(s + 12, f"Sec[{i}].VRVA")
            rsize = self._u32(s + 16, f"Sec[{i}].RSize")
            roff = self._u32(s + 20, f"Sec[{i}].ROff")
            if roff + rsize > self.size:
                self._fail(f"Section[{i}] raw data exceeds file bounds")
            self.sections.append((vrva, vsize, roff, rsize))

    def rva_to_offset(self, rva):
        if rva == 0:
            return 0
        for vrva, vsize, roff, rsize in self.sections:
            span = max(vsize, rsize)
            if vrva <= rva < vrva + span:
                delta = rva - vrva
                if delta >= rsize:
                    return -1
                return roff + delta
        return -1

    def _parse_cli(self):
        cli_off = self.rva_to_offset(self.cli_rva)
        if cli_off <= 0 or cli_off + 72 > self.size or self.cli_size > self.size - cli_off:
            self._fail("Unmapped or OOB CLI header RVA/Size")
        cb = self._u32(cli_off, "CLI.cb")
        if cb < 72:
            self._fail(f"Invalid CLI header cb={cb}")
        meta_rva = self._u32(cli_off + 8, "MetadataRVA")
        meta_size = self._u32(cli_off + 12, "MetadataSize")
        meta_off = self.rva_to_offset(meta_rva)
        if meta_off <= 0 or meta_size < 20 or meta_off + meta_size > self.size:
            self._fail("Invalid Metadata Root RVA/size")
        meta_end = meta_off + meta_size
        if self._u32(meta_off, "BSJB") != 0x424A5342:
            self._fail("Invalid Metadata BSJB signature")
        ver_len = self._u32(meta_off + 12, "VersionLength")
        ver_aligned = (ver_len + 3) & ~3
        if meta_off + 16 + ver_aligned + 4 > meta_end:
            self._fail("Metadata version string exceeds MetadataRoot")
        num_streams = self._u16(meta_off + 16 + ver_aligned + 2, "NumberOfStreams")
        pos = meta_off + 16 + ver_aligned + 4
        self.streams = {}
        for i in range(num_streams):
            if pos + 8 > meta_end:
                self._fail(f"Stream[{i}] header exceeds MetadataRoot")
            soff = self._u32(pos, f"Stream[{i}].Off")
            ssize = self._u32(pos + 4, f"Stream[{i}].Size")
            pos += 8
            end = self.data.find(b"\x00", pos, meta_end)
            if end == -1:
                self._fail(f"Unterminated stream name[{i}] within MetadataRoot")
            name = self.data[pos:end].decode("ascii", errors="replace")
            pos = (end + 4) & ~3
            if pos > meta_end:
                self._fail(f"Stream[{i}] aligned name exceeds MetadataRoot")
            abs_off = meta_off + soff
            if abs_off < meta_off or abs_off + ssize > meta_end:
                self._fail(f"Stream '{name}' exceeds MetadataRoot bounds (meta_off + meta_size)")
            self.streams[name] = (abs_off, ssize)
        for req in ("#~", "#Strings", "#US", "#Blob"):
            if req not in self.streams:
                self._fail(f"Required metadata stream missing: {req}")
        self._parse_tables()
    def get_string(self, idx):
        off, size = self.streams["#Strings"]
        if idx < 0 or idx >= size:
            return None
        end = self.data.find(b"\x00", off + idx, off + size)
        if end == -1:
            return None
        return self.data[off + idx:end].decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

    def get_user_string(self, offset):
        off, size = self.streams["#US"]
        if offset < 0 or offset >= size:
            return None
        p = off + offset
        b0 = self.data[p]
        if (b0 & 0x80) == 0:
            length = b0; p += 1
        elif (b0 & 0xC0) == 0x80:
            if p + 1 >= off + size: return None
            length = ((b0 & 0x3F) << 8) | self.data[p+1]; p += 2
        elif (b0 & 0xE0) == 0xC0:
            if p + 3 >= off + size: return None
            length = ((b0 & 0x1F) << 24) | (self.data[p+1] << 16) | (self.data[p+2] << 8) | self.data[p+3]; p += 4
        else:
            return None
        if length == 0:
            return ""
        if p + length > off + size:
            return None
        return self.data[p:p + length - 1].decode("utf-16le", errors="replace")

    def _parse_tables(self):
        off, tsize = self.streams["#~"]
        if tsize < 24:
            self._fail("#~ stream smaller than 24-byte header")
        heap_sizes = self.data[off + 6]
        valid_mask = self._u64(off + 8, "ValidMask")
        str_sz = 4 if (heap_sizes & 0x01) else 2
        guid_sz = 4 if (heap_sizes & 0x02) else 2
        blob_sz = 4 if (heap_sizes & 0x04) else 2

        pos = off + 24
        self.row_counts = {}
        for tid in range(64):
            if (valid_mask >> tid) & 1:
                if pos + 4 > off + tsize:
                    self._fail(f"RowCount[{tid}] exceeds #~ stream")
                self.row_counts[tid] = self._u32(pos, f"RowCount[{tid}]")
                pos += 4

        idx_sz = lambda tids: 4 if any(self.row_counts.get(t, 0) >= 65536 for t in tids) else 2
        coded_sz = lambda tids, bits: 4 if any(self.row_counts.get(t, 0) >= (1 << (16 - bits)) for t in tids) else 2

        td_or_tr = coded_sz([0x02, 0x01, 0x1B], 2)
        has_const = coded_sz([0x04, 0x08, 0x17], 2)
        has_ca = coded_sz([0x06, 0x04, 0x01, 0x02, 0x08, 0x09, 0x0A, 0x00, 0x0E, 0x17, 0x14, 0x11, 0x1A, 0x1B, 0x20, 0x23, 0x26, 0x27, 0x28], 5)
        has_fm = coded_sz([0x04, 0x08], 1)
        has_decl = coded_sz([0x02, 0x06, 0x20], 2)
        mr_parent = coded_sz([0x02, 0x01, 0x1A, 0x06, 0x1B], 3)
        has_sem = coded_sz([0x14, 0x17], 1)
        md_or_mr = coded_sz([0x06, 0x0A], 1)
        impl = coded_sz([0x04, 0x0A], 1)
        ca_type = coded_sz([0x06, 0x0A], 3)
        res_scope = coded_sz([0x00, 0x1A, 0x23, 0x01], 2)
        to_md = coded_sz([0x02, 0x06], 1)

        row_sizes = {
            0x00: 2 + str_sz + guid_sz * 3, 0x01: res_scope + str_sz * 2,
            0x02: 4 + str_sz * 2 + td_or_tr + idx_sz([0x04]) + idx_sz([0x06]),
            0x04: 2 + str_sz + blob_sz, 0x06: 4 + 2 + 2 + str_sz + blob_sz + idx_sz([0x08]),
            0x08: 2 + 2 + str_sz, 0x09: idx_sz([0x02]) + td_or_tr,
            0x0A: mr_parent + str_sz + blob_sz, 0x0B: 2 + has_const + blob_sz,
            0x0C: has_ca + ca_type + blob_sz, 0x0D: has_fm + blob_sz,
            0x0E: 2 + has_decl + blob_sz, 0x0F: 2 + 4 + idx_sz([0x02]),
            0x10: 4 + idx_sz([0x04]), 0x11: blob_sz,
            0x12: idx_sz([0x02]) + idx_sz([0x14]), 0x14: 2 + str_sz + td_or_tr,
            0x15: idx_sz([0x02]) + idx_sz([0x17]), 0x17: 2 + str_sz + blob_sz,
            0x18: 2 + idx_sz([0x06]) + has_sem, 0x19: idx_sz([0x02]) + md_or_mr + md_or_mr,
            0x1A: str_sz, 0x1B: blob_sz,
            0x1C: 2 + impl + str_sz + idx_sz([0x1A]), 0x1D: 4 + idx_sz([0x04]),
            0x20: 4 + 8 + 4 + blob_sz + str_sz * 2, 0x23: 8 + 4 + blob_sz + str_sz * 2 + blob_sz,
            0x26: 4 + 4 + str_sz + impl, 0x27: 4 + 4 + str_sz * 2 + impl,
            0x28: 4 + 4 + str_sz + impl, 0x29: idx_sz([0x02]) + idx_sz([0x02]),
            0x2A: 2 + 2 + to_md + str_sz, 0x2B: md_or_mr + blob_sz,
            0x2C: idx_sz([0x2A]) + td_or_tr,
        }

        table_offsets = {}
        for tid in range(64):
            cnt = self.row_counts.get(tid, 0)
            if cnt > 0:
                if tid not in row_sizes:
                    self._fail(f"Unsupported metadata table 0x{tid:02X}")
                table_offsets[tid] = pos
                pos += cnt * row_sizes[tid]
        if pos > off + tsize:
            self._fail("Metadata tables exceed #~ stream size")

        read_idx = lambda sz, p: self._u32(p) if sz == 4 else self._u16(p)

        self.types = {}
        typedefs = []
        for rid in range(1, self.row_counts.get(0x02, 0) + 1):
            r = table_offsets[0x02] + (rid - 1) * row_sizes[0x02]
            nm = self.get_string(read_idx(str_sz, r + 4))
            ns = self.get_string(read_idx(str_sz, r + 4 + str_sz))
            if nm is None or ns is None:
                self._fail(f"Invalid #Strings index in TypeDef[{rid}]")
            ml = read_idx(idx_sz([0x06]), r + 4 + str_sz * 2 + td_or_tr + idx_sz([0x04]))
            ft = f"{ns}.{nm}" if ns else nm
            self.types[0x02000000 | rid] = ft
            typedefs.append((rid, ft, ml))

        for rid in range(1, self.row_counts.get(0x01, 0) + 1):
            r = table_offsets[0x01] + (rid - 1) * row_sizes[0x01]
            nm = self.get_string(read_idx(str_sz, r + res_scope))
            ns = self.get_string(read_idx(str_sz, r + res_scope + str_sz))
            if nm is None or ns is None:
                self._fail(f"Invalid #Strings index in TypeRef[{rid}]")
            self.types[0x01000000 | rid] = f"{ns}.{nm}" if ns else nm

        self.methods = {}
        td_idx = 0
        for rid in range(1, self.row_counts.get(0x06, 0) + 1):
            while td_idx + 1 < len(typedefs) and typedefs[td_idx + 1][2] <= rid:
                td_idx += 1
            ft = typedefs[td_idx][1] if typedefs else "<Module>"
            r = table_offsets[0x06] + (rid - 1) * row_sizes[0x06]
            rva = self._u32(r)
            impl_flags = self._u16(r + 4)
            flags = self._u16(r + 6)
            nm = self.get_string(read_idx(str_sz, r + 8))
            if nm is None:
                self._fail(f"Invalid #Strings index in MethodDef[{rid}]")
            tok = 0x06000000 | rid
            foff = self.rva_to_offset(rva)
            self.methods[tok] = {
                "token": tok, "rid": rid, "type": ft, "name": nm,
                "rva": rva, "impl_flags": impl_flags, "flags": flags, "offset": foff
            }

        self.fields = {}
        for rid in range(1, self.row_counts.get(0x04, 0) + 1):
            r = table_offsets[0x04] + (rid - 1) * row_sizes[0x04]
            nm = self.get_string(read_idx(str_sz, r + 2))
            if nm is None:
                self._fail(f"Invalid #Strings index in FieldDef[{rid}]")
            self.fields[0x04000000 | rid] = nm

        self.memberrefs = {}
        for rid in range(1, self.row_counts.get(0x0A, 0) + 1):
            r = table_offsets[0x0A] + (rid - 1) * row_sizes[0x0A]
            nm = self.get_string(read_idx(str_sz, r + mr_parent))
            if nm is None:
                self._fail(f"Invalid #Strings index in MemberRef[{rid}]")
            self.memberrefs[0x0A000000 | rid] = nm

    def resolve_token(self, tok):
        tbl = tok >> 24
        rid = tok & 0x00FFFFFF
        if tbl == 0x70:
            us = self.get_user_string(rid)
            return (us is not None, f"US:'{us}'" if us is not None else f"INVALID_US:0x{tok:08X}")
        if rid == 0:
            return (False, f"ZERO_RID:0x{tok:08X}")
        if tbl == 0x06:
            m = self.methods.get(tok)
            return (m is not None, f"{m['type']}.{m['name']}" if m else f"INVALID_METHOD:0x{tok:08X}")
        if tbl == 0x04:
            f = self.fields.get(tok)
            return (f is not None, f"Field:{f}" if f else f"INVALID_FIELD:0x{tok:08X}")
        if tbl == 0x0A:
            mr = self.memberrefs.get(tok)
            return (mr is not None, f"Ref:{mr}" if mr else f"INVALID_MREF:0x{tok:08X}")
        if tbl in (0x01, 0x02):
            tp = self.types.get(tok)
            return (tp is not None, f"Type:{tp}" if tp else f"INVALID_TYPE:0x{tok:08X}")
        if tbl in (0x1B, 0x2B, 0x11):
            ok = rid <= self.row_counts.get(tbl, 0)
            return (ok, f"Tbl0x{tbl:02X}[{rid}]" if ok else f"INVALID_TOK:0x{tok:08X}")
        return (False, f"UNHANDLED_TBL:0x{tok:08X}")
ONE_BYTE = {
    0x00:("nop",0),0x01:("break",0),0x02:("ldarg.0",0),0x03:("ldarg.1",0),0x04:("ldarg.2",0),0x05:("ldarg.3",0),
    0x06:("ldloc.0",0),0x07:("ldloc.1",0),0x08:("ldloc.2",0),0x09:("ldloc.3",0),0x0A:("stloc.0",0),0x0B:("stloc.1",0),

    0x12:("ldloca.s",1),0x13:("stloc.s",1),0x14:("ldnull",0),0x15:("ldc.i4.m1",0),0x16:("ldc.i4.0",0),0x17:("ldc.i4.1",0),

    0x1E:("ldc.i4.8",0),0x1F:("ldc.i4.s",1),0x20:("ldc.i4",4),0x21:("ldc.i8",8),0x22:("ldc.r4","R4"),0x23:("ldc.r8","R8"),
    0x25:("dup",0),0x26:("pop",0),0x27:("jmp","TOK"),0x28:("call","TOK"),0x29:("calli","TOK"),0x2A:("ret",0),
    0x2B:("br.s","I1"),0x2C:("brfalse.s","I1"),0x2D:("brtrue.s","I1"),0x2E:("beq.s","I1"),0x2F:("bge.s","I1"),
    0x30:("bgt.s","I1"),0x31:("ble.s","I1"),0x32:("blt.s","I1"),0x33:("bne.un.s","I1"),0x34:("bge.un.s","I1"),
    0x35:("bgt.un.s","I1"),0x36:("ble.un.s","I1"),0x37:("blt.un.s","I1"),0x38:("br","I4"),0x39:("brfalse","I4"),

TWO_BYTE = {
    0x00:("arglist",0),0x01:("ceq",0),0x02:("cgt",0),0x03:("cgt.un",0),0x04:("clt",0),0x05:("clt.un",0),

    0x12:("unaligned.",1),0x13:("volatile.",0),0x14:("tail.",0),0x15:("initobj","TOK"),0x16:("constrained.","TOK"),
    0x17:("cpblk",0),0x18:("initblk",0),0x1A:("rethrow",0),0x1C:("sizeof","TOK"),0x1D:("refanytype",0),0x1E:("readonly.",0)
